### Set up function to compare demographics between a main and secondary sample 
```{r}

compare_samples <- function(
    df,
    main_col         = "main",
    secondary_col    = "secondary",
    continuous_vars  = NULL,
    categorical_vars = NULL,
    binary_vars      = NULL,
    output_file      = "sample_comparison.xlsx",
    age_col          = NULL                # e.g. "age"
) {

  secondary_df <- df[
    !is.na(df[[secondary_col]]) & df[[secondary_col]] == 1,
  ]
  main_df <- df[
    !is.na(df[[main_col]]) & df[[main_col]] == 1 &
    (is.na(df[[secondary_col]]) | df[[secondary_col]] != 1),
  ]
  main_full_df <- df[
    !is.na(df[[main_col]]) & df[[main_col]] == 1,
  ]

  n_main      <- nrow(main_df)
  n_secondary <- nrow(secondary_df)
  n_main_full <- nrow(main_full_df)
  n_overlap   <- sum(
    !is.na(df[[main_col]])      & df[[main_col]]      == 1 &
    !is.na(df[[secondary_col]]) & df[[secondary_col]] == 1
  )

  cat(sprintf(
    "\nSample sizes:\n  Main (excl. subset): %d\n  Subset (secondary): %d\n  Full main sample: %d\n  Overlap (in both): %d\n\n",
    n_main, n_secondary, n_main_full, n_overlap
  ))

  results <- list()

  fmt_p <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p))  return("NA")
    if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
    sprintf("%.3f", p)
  }
  stars <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p))  return("")
    if (p < 0.001) return("***")
    if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
    if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
    return("")
  }
  fmt_stat <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) return("NA")
    sprintf("%.3f", x)
  }

  # ---- Helper: age-adjusted p-value via ANCOVA --------------
  age_adjusted_p <- function(var, df_combined) {
    if (is.null(age_col)) return(NA)
    
    df_combined <- df_combined[!is.na(df_combined[[var]]) &
                               !is.na(df_combined[[age_col]]) &
                               !is.na(df_combined$`.group`), ]
    if (nrow(df_combined) < 10) return(NA)
    
    tryCatch({
      fit <- lm(
        as.formula(sprintf("`%s` ~ `.group` + `%s`", var, age_col)),
        data = df_combined
      )
      # Extract p-value for the group term
      coef_table <- summary(fit)$coefficients
      group_row  <- grep("^\\.group", rownames(coef_table))
      if (length(group_row) == 0) return(NA)
      coef_table[group_row[1], "Pr(>|t|)"]
    }, error = function(e) NA)
  }

  # ============================================================
  #  CONTINUOUS VARIABLES
  # ============================================================
  if (!is.null(continuous_vars)) {
    for (var in continuous_vars) {
      x_main      <- main_df[[var]]
      x_sec       <- secondary_df[[var]]
      x_main_full <- main_full_df[[var]]

      mean_main      <- mean(x_main,      na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_main        <- sd(x_main,        na.rm = TRUE)
      mean_sec       <- mean(x_sec,       na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_sec         <- sd(x_sec,         na.rm = TRUE)
      mean_main_full <- mean(x_main_full, na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_main_full   <- sd(x_main_full,   na.rm = TRUE)

      n_main_v      <- sum(!is.na(x_main))
      n_sec_v       <- sum(!is.na(x_sec))
      n_main_full_v <- sum(!is.na(x_main_full))

      nmiss_main      <- sum(is.na(x_main))
      nmiss_sec       <- sum(is.na(x_sec))
      nmiss_main_full <- sum(is.na(x_main_full))

      use_ttest <- n_main_v >= 30 & n_sec_v >= 30

      if (use_ttest) {
        test_res  <- t.test(x_main, x_sec)
        test_name <- "t-test"
        test_stat <- test_res$statistic
      } else {
        test_res  <- wilcox.test(x_main, x_sec)
        test_name <- "Wilcoxon"
        test_stat <- test_res$statistic
      }

      p <- test_res$p.value

      # Build combined df for ANCOVA
      df_combined <- rbind(
        data.frame(main_df[, c(var, age_col), drop = FALSE],      `.group` = "main"),
        data.frame(secondary_df[, c(var, age_col), drop = FALSE],  `.group` = "secondary")
      )
      p_adj <- age_adjusted_p(var, df_combined)

      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Variable        = var,
        Type            = "Continuous",
        Level           = "",
        Main            = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean_main,      sd_main),
        Secondary       = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean_sec,       sd_sec),
        Main_Full       = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean_main_full, sd_main_full),
        N_Main          = n_main_v,
        N_Secondary     = n_sec_v,
        N_Main_Full     = n_main_full_v,
        NMiss_Main      = nmiss_main,
        NMiss_Secondary = nmiss_sec,
        NMiss_Main_Full = nmiss_main_full,
        Test            = test_name,
        Test_Stat       = fmt_stat(test_stat),
        P_value         = fmt_p(p),
        Sig             = stars(p),
        P_adj_age       = fmt_p(p_adj),       # <-- new column
        Sig_adj         = stars(p_adj),        # <-- new column
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  #  BINARY VARIABLES
  # ============================================================
  if (!is.null(binary_vars)) {
    for (var in binary_vars) {
      x_main      <- main_df[[var]]
      x_sec       <- secondary_df[[var]]
      x_main_full <- main_full_df[[var]]

      n_m   <- sum(x_main      == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_s   <- sum(x_sec       == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_mf  <- sum(x_main_full == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

      tot_m  <- sum(!is.na(x_main))
      tot_s  <- sum(!is.na(x_sec))
      tot_mf <- sum(!is.na(x_main_full))

      pct_m  <- 100 * n_m  / tot_m
      pct_s  <- 100 * n_s  / tot_s
      pct_mf <- 100 * n_mf / tot_mf

      nmiss_main      <- sum(is.na(x_main))
      nmiss_sec       <- sum(is.na(x_sec))
      nmiss_main_full <- sum(is.na(x_main_full))

      tbl <- matrix(
        c(n_m, tot_m - n_m, n_s, tot_s - n_s),
        nrow = 2,
        dimnames = list(c("yes", "no"), c("main", "secondary"))
      )

      expected   <- outer(rowSums(tbl), colSums(tbl)) / sum(tbl)
      use_fisher <- any(expected < 5, na.rm = TRUE)

      test_res <- tryCatch({
        if (use_fisher) fisher.test(tbl) else chisq.test(tbl)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      p         <- if (!is.null(test_res)) test_res$p.value else NA
      test_stat <- if (!is.null(test_res)) {
        if (use_fisher) test_res$estimate else test_res$statistic
      } else NA
      test_name <- if (use_fisher) "Fisher" else "Chi-sq"

      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Variable        = var,
        Type            = "Binary",
        Level           = "=1 (yes)",
        Main            = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_m,  pct_m),
        Secondary       = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_s,  pct_s),
        Main_Full       = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_mf, pct_mf),
        N_Main          = tot_m,
        N_Secondary     = tot_s,
        N_Main_Full     = tot_mf,
        NMiss_Main      = nmiss_main,
        NMiss_Secondary = nmiss_sec,
        NMiss_Main_Full = nmiss_main_full,
        Test            = test_name,
        Test_Stat       = fmt_stat(test_stat),
        P_value         = fmt_p(p),
        Sig             = stars(p),
        P_adj_age       = "",   # not applicable for binary
        Sig_adj         = "",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  #  CATEGORICAL VARIABLES
  # ============================================================
  if (!is.null(categorical_vars)) {
    for (var in categorical_vars) {
      x_main      <- main_df[[var]]
      x_sec       <- secondary_df[[var]]
      x_main_full <- main_full_df[[var]]

      lvls <- sort(unique(c(as.character(x_main), as.character(x_sec))))
      lvls <- lvls[!is.na(lvls)]

      nmiss_main      <- sum(is.na(x_main))
      nmiss_sec       <- sum(is.na(x_sec))
      nmiss_main_full <- sum(is.na(x_main_full))

      tbl <- table(
        group = c(rep("main", length(x_main)), rep("secondary", length(x_sec))),
        value = c(as.character(x_main), as.character(x_sec))
      )

      expected   <- outer(rowSums(tbl), colSums(tbl)) / sum(tbl)
      use_fisher <- any(expected < 5, na.rm = TRUE)

      test_res <- tryCatch({
        if (use_fisher) {
          fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 2000)
        } else {
          chisq.test(tbl)
        }
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      p         <- if (!is.null(test_res)) test_res$p.value else NA
      test_stat <- if (!is.null(test_res)) {
        if (use_fisher) NA else test_res$statistic
      } else NA
      test_name <- if (use_fisher) "Fisher" else "Chi-sq"

      # Overall row
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Variable        = var,
        Type            = "Categorical",
        Level           = "[overall]",
        Main            = sprintf("n=%d", sum(!is.na(x_main))),
        Secondary       = sprintf("n=%d", sum(!is.na(x_sec))),
        Main_Full       = sprintf("n=%d", sum(!is.na(x_main_full))),
        N_Main          = sum(!is.na(x_main)),
        N_Secondary     = sum(!is.na(x_sec)),
        N_Main_Full     = sum(!is.na(x_main_full)),
        NMiss_Main      = nmiss_main,
        NMiss_Secondary = nmiss_sec,
        NMiss_Main_Full = nmiss_main_full,
        Test            = test_name,
        Test_Stat       = fmt_stat(test_stat),
        P_value         = fmt_p(p),
        Sig             = stars(p),
        P_adj_age       = "",   # not applicable for categorical
        Sig_adj         = "",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      # Per-level rows
      for (lvl in lvls) {
        n_m  <- sum(x_main      == lvl, na.rm = TRUE)
        n_s  <- sum(x_sec       == lvl, na.rm = TRUE)
        n_mf <- sum(x_main_full == lvl, na.rm = TRUE)

        pct_m  <- 100 * n_m  / sum(!is.na(x_main))
        pct_s  <- 100 * n_s  / sum(!is.na(x_sec))
        pct_mf <- 100 * n_mf / sum(!is.na(x_main_full))

        results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          Variable        = "",
          Type            = "",
          Level           = paste0("  ", lvl),
          Main            = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_m,  pct_m),
          Secondary       = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_s,  pct_s),
          Main_Full       = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_mf, pct_mf),
          N_Main          = n_m,
          N_Secondary     = n_s,
          N_Main_Full     = n_mf,
          NMiss_Main      = "",
          NMiss_Secondary = "",
          NMiss_Main_Full = "",
          Test            = "",
          Test_Stat       = "",
          P_value         = "",
          Sig             = "",
          P_adj_age       = "",
          Sig_adj         = "",
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  #  ASSEMBLE & EXPORT
  # ============================================================
  out <- do.call(rbind, results)
  rownames(out) <- NULL

  adj_label <- if (!is.null(age_col)) sprintf("P-value adj. (%s)", age_col) else "P-value adj. (age)"

  colnames(out) <- c(
    "Variable", "Type", "Level",
    sprintf("Main excl. subset (n=%d)", n_main),
    sprintf("Subset (n=%d)", n_secondary),
    sprintf("Full Main (n=%d)", n_main_full),
    "N_Main", "N_Secondary", "N_Main_Full",
    "NMissing_Main", "NMissing_Secondary", "NMissing_Main_Full",
    "Test", "Test Statistic", "P-value", "Sig.",
    adj_label, "Sig. (adj)"   # <-- new columns
  )

  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "Sample Comparison")

  sig_style     <- createStyle(fgFill = "#FFF3CD")
  sig_adj_style <- createStyle(fgFill = "#D6EAF8")  # light blue for age-adjusted hits

  writeDataTable(wb, sheet = 1, x = out, tableStyle = "TableStyleLight2",
                 withFilter = FALSE)

  sig_rows <- which(out[["Sig."]] %in% c("*", "**", "***")) + 1
  if (length(sig_rows) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet = 1, style = sig_style,
             rows = sig_rows, cols = 1:ncol(out), gridExpand = TRUE)
  }

  sig_adj_rows <- which(out[["Sig. (adj)"]] %in% c("*", "**", "***")) + 1
  if (length(sig_adj_rows) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet = 1, style = sig_adj_style,
             rows = sig_adj_rows, cols = ncol(out) - 1, gridExpand = TRUE)
  }

  setColWidths(wb, sheet = 1, cols = 1:ncol(out), widths = "auto")

  addWorksheet(wb, "Notes")
  notes <- data.frame(Note = c(
    sprintf("Full main sample (main==1): n = %d", n_main_full),
    sprintf("Main excl. subset (main==1, secondary!=1): n = %d", n_main),
    sprintf("Subset (secondary==1): n = %d", n_secondary),
    sprintf("Overlap (in both groups): n = %d", n_overlap),
    "Continuous: mean (SD); t-test if n>=30 in both groups, Wilcoxon otherwise",
    "Binary/Categorical: n (%); Chi-squared or Fisher if expected cell < 5",
    sprintf("Age-adjusted p-value: from lm(var ~ group + %s), continuous vars only", if (!is.null(age_col)) age_col else "age"),
    "Yellow highlight: unadjusted p < 0.05  |  Blue highlight: age-adjusted p < 0.05",
    "* p<0.05  ** p<0.01  *** p<0.001"
  ))
  writeData(wb, sheet = "Notes", x = notes)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet = "Notes", cols = 1, widths = 70)

  saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", output_file))

  invisible(out)
}

```

## Set up a tidying function for model outputs {.hidden}
```{r}

# Define a function that will take the lavaan output and put it into a tidy data frame format
tidy_lavaan_fit <- function(fit, original_data, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = NULL, brain_label = NULL, ses_label = NULL, outcome_label = NULL) {
  
  # Set up an error log
  log_error <- function(e) {
    error_msg <- paste(
      model_name, brain_label, ses_label, outcome_label, 
      sep = ", "
    )
    write(error_msg, file = paste0(output_path,"non_converged_models.txt"), append = TRUE)
    return(NULL) # Return NULL so the pipeline doesn't crash
  }

  # 2. Wrap extraction in tryCatch
  tryCatch({
    
    # Check if the model actually converged
    if (!lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "converged")) {
      stop("Model did not converge")
    }
  
  
  # Standardized solution
  std_plot <- parameterEstimates(fit)
  std <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(fit) %>%
    mutate(
      term = paste(lhs, op, rhs),
      estimate = est.std,
      std.error = se,          
      p.value = pvalue,
      model = model_name,
      ses_label = ses_label,
      brain_label = brain_label,
      outcome_label = outcome_label,
      # Label parameter type
      param_type = case_when(
        op == "=~" ~ "latent variable",
        op == "~"  ~ "regression",
        op == "~~" & lhs == rhs ~ "variance",
        op == "~~" & lhs != rhs ~ "covariance",
        op == "~1" ~ "intercept",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ),
      # New columns
      interest_path_a = ifelse(term %in% c("i ~ SES_T1", "s ~ SES_T1"), "y", NA_character_),
      interest_path_ind = ifelse(term %in% c("ab1 := a1*b1", "ab2 := a2*b2", 
                                             "ab3 := a1*b3",  "ab4 := a2*b4"), "y",
                                 NA_character_),
      sig = ifelse((!is.na(interest_path_a) | !is.na(interest_path_ind)) & p.value < 0.05, "*", "")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, p.value, param_type, ses_label, brain_label, outcome_label, interest_path_a, interest_path_ind, sig)
  
  # Raw estimates
  raw <- broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name, ses_label = ses_label, brain_label = brain_label, 
      outcome_label = outcome_label)
  
  # gives standardised beta, unstandardised b se p and CI  
  interest_estimates <- lavaan::parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    term      = paste(lhs, op, rhs),
    estimate  = std.all,        # standardized beta
    p.value   = pvalue,         # UNSTANDARDISED p (populated for := rows)
    model         = model_name,
    ses_label     = ses_label,
    brain_label   = brain_label,
    outcome_label = outcome_label,
    param_type = case_when(
      op == "=~" ~ "latent variable",
      op == "~"  ~ "regression",
      op == "~~" & lhs == rhs ~ "variance",
      op == "~~" & lhs != rhs ~ "covariance",
      op == "~1" ~ "intercept",
      op == ":=" ~ "defined (indirect)",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    interest_path_a   = ifelse(term %in% c("i ~ SES_T1", "s ~ SES_T1", 
                                           "i ~ SES_household_T1", "s ~ SES_household_T1",
                                           "i ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1", "s ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1"), "y", NA_character_),
    interest_path_ind = ifelse(term %in% c("ab1 := a1*b1", "ab2 := a2*b2",
                                           "ab3 := a1*b3", "ab4 := a2*b4",
                                           "abiho := a1*b1", "absho := a2*b2",
                                           "abine := a3*b1", "absne := a4*b2"), "y", NA_character_),
    sig = ifelse((!is.na(interest_path_a) | !is.na(interest_path_ind)) & p.value < 0.05, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(interest_path_a) | !is.na(interest_path_ind)) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, p.value, param_type, ses_label,
                brain_label, outcome_label, interest_path_a, interest_path_ind, sig)
  
  # Fit measures
  fm <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit)
  fm_df <- data.frame(
    measure = names(fm),
    value = as.numeric(fm),
    model = model_name,
    ses_label = ses_label,
    brain_label = brain_label,
    outcome_label = outcome_label
  )
  
  # Add R-squared for Brain_T1 through Brain_T4
  brain_vars <- c("Brain_T1", "Brain_T2", "Brain_T3", "Brain_T4")
  r2_raw <- lavaan::inspect(fit, "r2")
  available_brain_vars <- brain_vars[brain_vars %in% names(r2_raw)]
  
  r2_df <- data.frame(
    measure       = paste0("r2.", available_brain_vars),
    value         = as.numeric(r2_raw[available_brain_vars]),
    model         = model_name,
    ses_label     = ses_label,
    brain_label   = brain_label,
    outcome_label = outcome_label
  )
  
  # Add notes about model fit for chi-square, RMSEA, SRMR, CFI and TLI
  fm_df <- bind_rows(fm_df, r2_df) %>%
  mutate(
    notes = case_when(

      measure %in% c("rmsea.robust", "srmr") & value < 0.05 ~ "excellent",
      measure %in% c("rmsea.robust", "srmr") & value < 0.08 ~ "acceptable",

      measure %in% c("cfi.robust", "tli.robust") & value > 0.95 ~ "excellent",
      measure %in% c("cfi.robust", "tli.robust") & value > 0.90 ~ "acceptable",

      measure %in% c("rmsea.robust", "cfi.robust", "tli.robust", "srmr") ~ "poor",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
  
fs <- tryCatch({
    scores <- lavPredict(fit)
    keep_cols <- intersect(c("i", "s"), colnames(scores))
    
    if (length(keep_cols) == 0) {
      NULL
    } else {
      scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE])
      
      # Get the row indices lavaan actually used (handles listwise deletion from fixed.x = FALSE)
      used_rows <- lavInspect(fit, "case.idx")
      
      if (length(used_rows) != nrow(scores_df)) {
        warning("Mismatch between case indices and factor score rows — IDs not attached")
        scores_df <- data.frame(row_index = seq_len(nrow(scores_df)), scores_df)
      } else {
        scores_df <- data.frame(ID = original_data[[id_col]][used_rows], scores_df)
      }
      
      scores_df %>%
        mutate(
          model         = model_name,
          ses_label     = ses_label,
          brain_label   = brain_label,
          outcome_label = outcome_label
        )
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Could not extract factor scores:", e$message))
    NULL
  })

  list(
    reporting = interest_estimates,
    standardized_estimates = std,
    raw_estimates = raw,
    fit_statistics  = fm_df,
    plot_values = std_plot,
    factor_scores = fs
  )
  
  }, error = log_error)
}

```

```{r}

if (run_longCombat_int) {

# 1. Prepare the data ####
data_curr <- data # using all possible data
data_curr$SES_house_ses00A <- data_curr$SES_household
data_curr$SES_neigh_ses00A <- data_curr$SES_neighbourhood
data_curr$SES_house_ses02A <- data_curr$SES_household
data_curr$SES_neigh_ses02A <- data_curr$SES_neighbourhood
data_curr$SES_house_ses04A <- data_curr$SES_household
data_curr$SES_neigh_ses04A <- data_curr$SES_neighbourhood
data_curr$SES_house_ses06A <- data_curr$SES_household
data_curr$SES_neigh_ses06A <- data_curr$SES_neighbourhood
data_curr$Sex_ses00A <- data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A
data_curr$Sex_ses02A <- data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A
data_curr$Sex_ses04A <- data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A
data_curr$Sex_ses06A <- data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A
cols_pivot <- data_curr %>% dplyr::select(c(                                      starts_with("ab_g_dyn__visit_age"), starts_with("Sex_"), 
                starts_with("SES_house_"), starts_with("SES_neigh_"), starts_with("ab_g_dyn__design_mr__model"), starts_with("ab_g_dyn__design_site"),
                starts_with("mr_y_smri__area__dsk"), starts_with("mr_y_smri__vol__dsk"), 
                starts_with("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk"))) %>% names()
target_list <- cols_pivot[grepl("ses00A|ses02A|ses04A|ses06A", cols_pivot)]
data_subset <- data_curr %>%
  dplyr::select("participant_id", all_of(target_list))
data_long <- data_subset %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(target_list),
    names_to = c(".value", "Wave"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(ses.*)"
  )

## Add Scanner-Site column
data_long <- data_long %>%
  mutate(Scanner_Site = ifelse(is.na(ab_g_dyn__design_site) | is.na(ab_g_dyn__design_mr__model), 
                            NA_character_, 
                            paste(ab_g_dyn__design_mr__model, ab_g_dyn__design_site, sep = "_")))
## If any Scanner_Site groups have only 1-3 people then remove them (only affects 4 scansm like single person with Orchestra scanner) as ComBat cannot estimate them
data_long <- data_long %>% group_by(Scanner_Site) %>%
  mutate(Scanner_Site = ifelse(n() < 4, NA_character_, Scanner_Site)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Filter to complete cases only ####
brain_regions <- names(data_long)[9:221]
## ComBat will crash if it sees an NA
data_complete <- data_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(Scanner_Site)) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(brain_regions), ab_g_dyn__visit_age, Sex) %>%
  dplyr::select(-SES_house, -SES_neigh, -ab_g_dyn__design_mr__model, -ab_g_dyn__design_site)
data_complete$Scanner_Site <- factor(data_complete$Scanner_Site)

# 3. Prepare the components for combat ####
## Get baseline age and age since baseline
data_complete <- data_complete %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    visit_index   = as.integer(factor(Wave, levels = unique(Wave))),
    baseline_age = ab_g_dyn__visit_age[visit_index == min(visit_index)],
    time_since_bl = ab_g_dyn__visit_age - baseline_age
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

## Select all your brain columns to create the matrix for ComBat
brain_regions_chunk <- c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean", "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum", "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum")

## Remove some data frames we don't need 
rm(data_curr)
rm(data_long)
rm(data_subset)

# 4. Execute ComBat ####
combat_results <- longCombat(
  idvar = "participant_id",
  timevar = "ab_g_dyn__visit_age",
  batchvar = "Scanner_Site",
  features = brain_regions,
  formula = "ab_g_dyn__visit_age + Sex",
  ranef = "(1|participant_id)",
  data = data_complete
)

# 5. Grab the harmonized data and merge back in ####
## Create a new list of names by adding a suffix
clean_names <- paste0(brain_regions, ".combat")
## Assign the combat matrix to these new columns
data_complete <- data_complete %>%
  left_join(combat_results$data_combat, by = c("participant_id", "ab_g_dyn__visit_age"))

## Remove the demographic variables
cols_to_pivot <- c(brain_regions, clean_names)
data_wide_all <- data_complete %>%
  dplyr::select(participant_id, Wave, all_of(cols_to_pivot)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Wave,
    values_from = all_of(cols_to_pivot),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Wave}"
  )
## Merge back with main dataset
clean_to_merge <- data_wide_all %>%
  dplyr::select(participant_id, contains(".combat")) # Only grab ID and the harmonized brain data
data_longCB <- data %>%
  left_join(clean_to_merge, by = "participant_id")

# 6. Save harmonized data ####
saveRDS(data_longCB, paste0(output_path,"lgcm_ComBatdata.rds"))

} else { 
  print("Longitudinal Combat harmonization already completed for scanner and site (preserving age and sex) using random intercept model, and not rerun")
  data_longCB <- readRDS(paste0(output_path,"lgcm_ComBatdata.rds"))
  data_longCB <- data_longCB %>%
    mutate(across(where(~ inherits(., "IDate")), as.Date))
}
```

First, we test linear and latent basis functions, and compare fit statistics to get the best fitting trajectory form for brain slopes

## Check the model form we should take (linear vs latent basis)
```{r}

print("Checking linear or latent basis as underlying model form and saving results")

#for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the linear model 
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept et pente latents
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  
  # Moyennes
  i ~ 1
  s ~ 1
'

# Define the free curve model or nonlinear latent growth model
model_latent_basis <- '
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + l1*Brain_T2 + l2*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
   
  i ~ 1
  s ~ 1
'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {

  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], 
          data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], 
          data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], 
          data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      
  
  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, brain only", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = "none", outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
  
  fit_latent_basis <- growth(model_latent_basis, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A")
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_latent_basis, model_name = "latent basis, brain only", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = "none", outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
  
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, "0_check_modelform_", combat_type,".xlsx")
)
}
```

```{r}

# Shared color palette
group_colors <- c("Low SES" = "#B4D4B6", "Mean SES" = "#6FA172", "High SES" = "#3E7341")

make_traj_plot <- function(d) {
  ggplot(d$traj, aes(x = time, y = M_hat, color = SES_group, group = SES_group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, name = d$x_name) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3), labels = paste0("T", 1:4)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = d$m_name) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

make_bar_plot <- function(summary_df, group_var, growth_factor, d) {
  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = .data[[group_var]], y = Y_mean, fill = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Y_mean - 1.96 * Y_se,
                      ymax = Y_mean + 1.96 * Y_se),
                  width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = d$y_name,
         title = paste0(d$m_name, " ", growth_factor, " \u2192 ", "\n", d$y_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5))
}

make_bar_plot_grey <- function(summary_df, group_var, growth_factor, d) {
  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = .data[[group_var]], y = Y_mean, fill = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Y_mean - 1.96 * Y_se,
                      ymax = Y_mean + 1.96 * Y_se),
                  width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey","grey","grey")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = d$y_name,
         title = paste0(d$m_name, " ", growth_factor, " \u2192 ", "\n", d$y_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5))
}
```

## Prepare regions
```{r}
# First average combatted values for left and right 

# Get all relevant columns that have been harmonized
cols <- names(data_longCB) %>% grep("_(lh|rh)_", ., value = TRUE) %>% grep("\\.combat", ., value = TRUE)

# Extract unique "base patterns" by removing lh/rh
base_patterns <- cols %>%
  str_replace("_(lh|rh)_", "_lrav_") %>%
  unique()

# For each base pattern, find lh + rh columns and average them
for (pat in base_patterns) {
  lh_col <- str_replace(pat, "_lrav_", "_lh_")
  rh_col <- str_replace(pat, "_lrav_", "_rh_")
  
  if (lh_col %in% names(data_longCB) && rh_col %in% names(data_longCB)) {
    data_longCB[[pat]] <- rowMeans(data_longCB[, c(lh_col, rh_col)], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}


# Get all relevant columns that have been harmonized
cols <- names(data_longCB_int_nonlinear) %>% grep("_(lh|rh)_", ., value = TRUE) %>% grep("\\.combat", ., value = TRUE)

# Extract unique "base patterns" by removing lh/rh
base_patterns <- cols %>%
  str_replace("_(lh|rh)_", "_lrav_") %>%
  unique()

# For each base pattern, find lh + rh columns and average them
for (pat in base_patterns) {
  lh_col <- str_replace(pat, "_lrav_", "_lh_")
  rh_col <- str_replace(pat, "_lrav_", "_rh_")
  
  if (lh_col %in% names(data_longCB_int_nonlinear) && rh_col %in% names(data_longCB_int_nonlinear)) {
    data_longCB_int_nonlinear[[pat]] <- rowMeans(data_longCB_int_nonlinear[, c(lh_col, rh_col)], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
print("Running models for Aim 1 (SES -> Brain)")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  
  # Define the LCGM
  model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex # no MRI model or site as ComBat removed already
  
'
  
  # Set up empty frames to store outputs
  all_raw <- data.frame()
  all_std <- data.frame()
  all_fit <- data.frame()
  all_report <- data.frame()
  all_factors <- data.frame()
  
  # Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
  for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                    "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                    "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
    
    for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
      
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      
      # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
      br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      
      # Define the current SES variable and standardize
      data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
      
      # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
      data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
      ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
      m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
      sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
      
      fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
      out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
      all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
      all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
      all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
        all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
      all_factors <- bind_rows(all_factors, out$factor_scores)
      
      # print full model output 
      output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim1_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
      # Open the file for appending results

      # Sex_mean <- mean(data_curr$Sex, na.rm = TRUE)

      # p_i_SES <- params$pvalue[params$lhs == "i" & params$rhs == "SES_T1" & params$op == "~"]
      # p_s_SES <- params$pvalue[params$lhs == "s" & params$rhs == "SES_T1" & params$op == "~"]
      # label_text <- paste0("Intercept: p = ", round(p_i_SES, 4),

      #   ## Make data frame
      # traj_SES <- expand.grid(time = time_point, SES_T1 = SES_level) %>%

      #     SES_label   = factor(SES_T1, levels = SES_level, labels = SES_label),
      #     pred_i     = i_intercept + i_SES * SES_T1 + i_Sex * Sex_mean,

    }
  }
  
  # FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
  path <- "interest_path_a"
  all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
```

```{r}
data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1)

for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat",

  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {

long_data <- data_curr %>% 
  select(participant_id, SES_household, SES_neighbourhood, brain_diff,
         ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, 
         ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A,
         paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A"), paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A"), 
         paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A"), paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(participant_id, SES_household, SES_neighbourhood, brain_diff),
    names_to = c(".value", "session"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_ses(\\d+)"
  )
m_br <- mean(long_data[[brain_v]], na.rm = T)
sd_br <- sd(long_data[[brain_v]], na.rm = T)
long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(brain_z = (long_data[[brain_v]] - m_br) / sd_br)

# Get the model info for plotting including parameters for intercept and slope
params <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_rInt", suffix,".xlsx"), sheet = "raw_estimates")
params <- params |> 
  filter(ses_label   == ses_v,
         brain_label == brain_v)
i_intercept <- params |> filter(term == "i ~1")        |> pull(estimate)
s_intercept <- params |> filter(term == "s ~1")        |> pull(estimate)
i_SS        <- params |> filter(term == "i ~ SES_T1")  |> pull(estimate)
s_SS        <- params |> filter(term == "s ~ SES_T1")  |> pull(estimate)
i_Sex       <- params |> filter(term == "i ~ Sex")     |> pull(estimate)
s_Sex       <- params |> filter(term == "s ~ Sex")     |> pull(estimate)
sex_ref <- 0
# wave mean ages for x-axis (raw years)
wave_ages <- c(10, 12, 14, 16)
# SES values
ss_mean <- mean(data_curr[[ses_v]], na.rm = TRUE)
ss_sd   <- sd(data_curr[[ses_v]],   na.rm = TRUE)

ss_vals <- c(
  "Mean - SD" = -1,
  "Mean"      =  0,
  "Mean + SD" =  1
)

# Estimate some model trajectories
implied_i_lo <- i_intercept + i_SS * (-1) + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_lo <- s_intercept + s_SS * (-1) + s_Sex * sex_ref

implied_i_mid <- i_intercept + i_SS * 0 + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_mid <- s_intercept + s_SS * 0 + s_Sex * sex_ref

implied_i_hi <- i_intercept + i_SS * (1) + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_hi <- s_intercept + s_SS * (1) + s_Sex * sex_ref

# fine t grid spanning the observed waves (t = 0..3)
t_grid   <- seq(0, 3, length.out = 100)
# map t back to age: age = 10 + 2*t  (since waves are 10,12,14,16)

lgcm_lines <- bind_rows(
  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_lo  + implied_s_lo  * t, ss_group = "Mean - SD"),
  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_mid + implied_s_mid * t, ss_group = "Mean"),
  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_hi  + implied_s_hi  * t, ss_group = "Mean + SD")
) |>
  mutate(ss_group = factor(ss_group, levels = c("Mean - SD", "Mean", "Mean + SD")))

# Plot the result
plot_raw <- ggplot() +
  # Raw spaghetti lines per person (standardized brain values)
  geom_line(data = long_data,
            aes(x = ab_g_dyn__visit_age, y = brain_z, group = participant_id),
            color = "grey70", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.1) +

  geom_line(data = lgcm_lines,

                color = ss_group, linetype = ss_group),

  #geom_point(data = lgcm_lines,

  scale_color_manual(

  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = brain_label) +
  theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
                          axis.text = element_text(size = 20),  
                          axis.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold")) + 
  guides(
  color = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      linewidth = 1.2,
      linetype  = c("dashed", "longdash", "solid"),
      shape     = NA)))
ggsave(paste0(output_path,"plots/other/",num,"_Aim1_output_linear_direction_plot_",brain_v,"_", ses_v, suffix,".png"), plot = plot_raw, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

plot_raw2 <- plot_raw +

                     expand = c(0.01, 0)) + theme(legend.position = "none",
                     plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10))
ggsave(paste0(output_path,"plots/other/",num,"_Aim1_output_linear_direction_plot_",brain_v,"_", ses_v,suffix,"_restrictY.png"), plot = plot_raw2, width = 4.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Make intercept and slope boxplots for supp

long_data$ses_group <- factor(ifelse(long_data[[ses_v]] < (ss_mean - ss_sd), "Low",

data_t1 <- long_data[long_data$session == "00" & !(is.na(long_data$ses_group)), ]
```

```{r}
      data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

      data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
      ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
      m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
      sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
  all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)

    }
  }

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {

  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
```

```{r}

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting")
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1", "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1", "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
#global_max_aim1 <- global_max
global_max_aim1 <- 0.3 # change here to manually set coloubar bounds

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  filter(interest_path_a == "y") %>%
  select(-sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(brain_label)
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  tbl <- tryCatch( 
    { tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # Blue gradient for negative + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] < 0,
      palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
      domain = c(global_min, 0),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    ) },
    error = function(e) {
      tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    )
    }
  )
  
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "_colourtable.html"))

}
```

## Aim 2
### Global model
```{r}

print("Running models for Aim 2 (SES -> Brain -> Outcomes)")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates
  i ~ a1*SES_T1 + Sex
  s ~ a2*SES_T1 + Sex
  
  # Mediators to outcome
  Outcome_T4 ~ b1*i + b2*s
  
  # Direct effect of predictor to outcome (and time-invariant covariates)
  Outcome_T4 ~ c_prime*SES_T1 + Sex + Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Indirect effects of predictor to outcome via mediators
  ab1 := a1*b1
  ab2 := a2*b2
  
  # Total effect
  total := c_prime + ab1 + ab2

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()
plot_data <- list()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    for (outcome_v in c("fc_p_sag_005_ses06A", 
                        "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR",
                    cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim2_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", outcome_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
      }
    }
}

  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}
```

```{r}
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4

  # Total effect
  total := c_prime + ab1 + ab2
  total_indirect := (a1*b1) + (a2*b2)

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
regions <- names(data_curr)[grep("lrav", names(data_curr))]
regions <- regions[!grepl("dsk__lrav", regions)]
region_list <- unique(substr(regions, 1, nchar(regions) - 7))
for (brain_v in region_list) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    for (outcome_v in c(                  "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A",
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A", "fc_p_sag_005_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T3 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  #output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, "regional/2_Aim2_output_regional_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", outcome_v, "_", combat_type, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  #capture.output({
  #cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  #brain_v
  #ses_v
  #summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
    }
  }
}

path <- "interest_path_ind"

all_report$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {

  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr")
```

### - Regional brain plots: Aim 2
```{r}

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- suppressWarnings(read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting"))
  all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab1 := a1*b1"), "InterceptMediator")) %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab2 := a2*b2"), "SlopeMediator"))
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max_aim2 <- global_max

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  relocate(outcome_label, .before = everything()) %>%
  select(-sig) %>%  # only keep what you need
  filter(interest_path_ind == "y") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome_label, brain_label) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  red_rows   <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] > 0
  blue_rows  <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] < 0
  white_rows <- is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) | is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) | df_wide[[fdr_col]] > 0.05
  
  if (any(red_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = red_rows,
        palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
        domain = c(0, global_max),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(blue_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = blue_rows,
        palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
        domain = c(global_min, 0),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(white_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = white_rows,
        palette = c("white", "white"),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix,"_colourtable.html"))
```

# 2. Secondary: Full sample [PGS + PCs, participants with genetic data]
```{r}
num <- '2'
suffix <- "_Whole_PGSPC"
```

## Aim 1
### Global model
```{r}

print("Running models for Aim 1 (SES -> Brain) for people with genetic data, controlling for PGS of brain volume")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes) for people with genetics data
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1 + genPC01_T1 + genPC02_T1 + genPC03_T1 + genPC04_T1 + genPC05_T1 + genPC06_T1 + genPC07_T1 + genPC08_T1 + genPC09_T1 + genPC10_T1
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1 + genPC01_T1 + genPC02_T1 + genPC03_T1 + genPC04_T1 + genPC05_T1 + genPC06_T1 + genPC07_T1 + genPC08_T1 + genPC09_T1 + genPC10_T1

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]],data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))

  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC01_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__01_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC02_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__02_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC03_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__03_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC04_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__04_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC05_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__05_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC06_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__06_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC07_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__07_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC08_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__08_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC09_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__09_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC10_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__10_ses00A)
  
  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(genetics_available == 1)
    
  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim1_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
  }
}
```

### Regional model 
```{r}

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1 + genPC01_T1 + genPC02_T1 + genPC03_T1 + genPC04_T1 + genPC05_T1 + genPC06_T1 + genPC07_T1 + genPC08_T1 + genPC09_T1 + genPC10_T1
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1 + genPC01_T1 + genPC02_T1 + genPC03_T1 + genPC04_T1 + genPC05_T1 + genPC06_T1 + genPC07_T1 + genPC08_T1 + genPC09_T1 + genPC10_T1

'


# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each bilateral regional measure and save output for each model and measure
regions <- names(data_curr)[grep("lrav", names(data_curr))]
regions <- regions[!grepl("dsk__lrav", regions)]
region_list <- unique(substr(regions, 1, nchar(regions) - 7))
for (brain_v in region_list) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      
      # Define the current SES variable and standardize
      data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
      
      # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
      data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
      ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
      m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
      sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
      
  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC01_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__01_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC02_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__02_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC03_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__03_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC04_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__04_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC05_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__05_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC06_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__06_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC07_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__07_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC08_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__08_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC09_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__09_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC10_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__10_ses00A)
  
  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(genetics_available == 1)

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
  all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)

    }
  }

}
```

### - Regional brain plots: Aim 1
```{r}

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting")
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1", "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1", "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
#global_max_aim1 <- global_max
global_max_aim1 <- 0.3 # change here to manually set coloubar bounds

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  filter(interest_path_a == "y") %>%
  select(-sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(brain_label)
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  tbl <- tryCatch( 
    { tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # Blue gradient for negative + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] < 0,
      palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
      domain = c(global_min, 0),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    ) },
    error = function(e) {
      tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    )
    }
  )
  
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "_colourtable.html"))

}

# Prepare template brain

# Create the brain plots for each sMRI and SES measure
  
  for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_",

                           ses_v, "_", effect, suffix, "_betaPassFDR_colorbar.png"))
      fsbrain::coloredmesh.plot.colorbar.separate(

        show = FALSE, # don't pop up a window
        image.plot_extra_options = list(
        legend.lab  = "Beta",
        horizontal  = TRUE, # horizontal bar (default)
        legend.cex  = .65,
        legend.line = -1.6,
        smallplot = c(0.1, 0.9, 0.15, 0.17),
        axis.args = list(cex.axis = .65, # text size; tweak to taste
        cex.axis = .7, 
        mgp = c(3, 0.5, 0))
        ),
        png_options = list(
        filename = cbar_path,
        width    = 1400,            # pixels; make it big, you can down-scale later
        height   = 1400,
        res      = 300,
        bg       = "white"    # transparent background (RGBA)
        ),
      trim_png = TRUE               # auto-crop away empty marge (needs {magick})
      )
      
      # Save the final PNG with a plot title and the colourbar
      ## Reopen the brain plot and colourbar PNGs 
      img <- image_read(img_path)
      img_cbar  <- image_read(cbar_path)

      info <- image_info(img)
      w_half <- info$width / 2
      h_half <- info$height / 2
      
      top_l <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, 0, 0)))
      btm_r <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, w_half, h_half)))

      # Combine into a single side-by-side row
      combined_brains <- image_append(

      ## Set up the title information
      effect_t <- ifelse(effect == "i ~ SES_T1", " -> Intercept of ", " -> Slope of ")
      brain_t <- ifelse(brain_v == "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_", "Regional Volume",

      ses_t <- ifelse(ses_v == "SES_neighbourhood", "Neighbourhood SES", "Household SES")
      title <- paste0(ses_t, effect_t, brain_t)

      # Close the current viewer
```
