## Aim 1
### Global models
```{r}

print("Running models for Aim 1 (SES -> Brain) for all people with genetic data, controlling for PGS of brain volume")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes) for people with genetics data
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]],data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))

  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_resid_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_resid_ses00A)
  
  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(genetics_available == 1)
    
  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim1_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
  }
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_std$fdr[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_std$p.value[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}
```

```{r}
implied_s_lo <- s_intercept + s_SS * (-1) + s_Sex * sex_ref

implied_s_mid <- s_intercept + s_SS * 0 + s_Sex * sex_ref
```

###  Regional models 
```{r}
for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1

'
  
# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each bilateral regional measure and save output for each model and measure
regions <- names(data_curr)[grep("lrav", names(data_curr))]
regions <- regions[!grepl("dsk__lrav", regions)]
region_list <- unique(substr(regions, 1, nchar(regions) - 7))
for (brain_v in region_list) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      
      # Define the current SES variable and standardize
      data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
      
      # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
      data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
      ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
      m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
      sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_resid_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_resid_ses00A)

  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(genetics_available == 1)

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  #output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, "regional/3_Aim1_S2a_Regional_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, "_PGScov_EuroResidPGS.txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  #capture.output({
  #cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  #brain_v
  #ses_v
  #summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
  }
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_std$fdr[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_std$p.value[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}
```

### - Regional brain plots: Aim 1
```{r}

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
 # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting")
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  filter(interest_path_a == "y") %>%
  select(-sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(brain_label)
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
if (global_min < 0) {
  for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  tbl <- tryCatch( 
    { tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # Blue gradient for negative + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] < 0,
      palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
      domain = c(global_min, 0),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    ) },
    error = function(e) {
      tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    )
    } )
    } } else {
      for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  tbl <- tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05 (no negative values)
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    )
    }
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "colourtable.html"))

}

        border = list(color = "grey90")
        )

      # Save png of brain image
      img_path <- file.path(output_path, paste0("plots/gene_corrected/", num, "_Aim1_brain_", 
                      brain_v, "_",  ses_v, "_", effect, suffix,  "betaPassFDR.png"))
      rgl::snapshot3d(filename = img_path,
        width = 4000, height = 4000, res = 600,
        webshot  = FALSE)
      
      # Save the plot at interactive html 
      brain_widget <- rgl::rglwidget(width = 900, height = 600)   # interactive WebGL
      htmlwidgets::saveWidget(widget = brain_widget,
        file = file.path(output_path, paste0("plots/htmls/", num, "_Aim1_brain_", brain_v, "_", 
                              ses_v, "_", effect, suffix,  "betaPassFDR.html")),
        selfcontained = FALSE)

      # Save colourbar for the brain image
      cbar_path <- file.path(output_path, paste0("plots/colourbars/", num, "_Aim1_brain_", 
                           brain_v, "_", 
                           ses_v, "_", effect, suffix,  "betaPassFDR.png"))
      fsbrain::coloredmesh.plot.colorbar.separate(
        coloredmeshes = cm, # the object returned by vis.*
        show = FALSE, # don't pop up a window
        image.plot_extra_options = list(
        legend.lab  = "Beta",
        horizontal  = TRUE, # horizontal bar (default)
        legend.cex  = .65,
        legend.line = -1.6,
        smallplot = c(0.1, 0.9, 0.15, 0.17),
        axis.args = list(cex.axis = .65, # text size; tweak to taste
        cex.axis = .7, 
        mgp = c(3, 0.5, 0))
        ),
        png_options = list(
        filename = cbar_path,
        width    = 1400,            # pixels; make it big, you can down-scale later
        height   = 1400,
        res      = 300,
        bg       = "white"    # transparent background (RGBA)
        ),
      trim_png = TRUE               # auto-crop away empty marge (needs {magick})
      )
      
      # Save the final PNG with a plot title and the colourbar
      ## Reopen the brain plot and colourbar PNGs 
      img <- image_read(img_path)
      img_cbar  <- image_read(cbar_path)
      ## Trim the white space
      ### Crop around each brain separately
      info <- image_info(img)
      w_half <- info$width / 2
      h_half <- info$height / 2
      
      top_l <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, 0, 0)))
      btm_r <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, w_half, h_half)))

      # Combine into a single side-by-side row
      combined_brains <- image_append(
        c(image_border(top_l, "white", "5x5"),
         image_border(btm_r, "white", "5x5")),
        stack = FALSE
      )
      # Code for if you have left and right regions that are different (2x2 plot)
      # top_l <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, 0, 0)))
      # top_r <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, w_half, 0)))
      # btm_l <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, 0, h_half)))
      # btm_r <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, w_half, h_half)))
      # ### Recombine the images
      # row1 <- image_append(c(image_border(top_l, "white", "5x5"), 
      #                  image_border(top_r, "white", "5x5")), stack = FALSE)
      # row2 <- image_append(c(image_border(btm_l, "white", "5x5"), 
      #                  image_border(btm_r, "white", "5x5")), stack = FALSE)
      # row2 <- image_resize(row2, geometry_size_pixels(width = image_info(row1)$width))
      # combined_brains <- image_append(c(row1, row2), stack = TRUE)
      
      ### Add a small border and space for the title
      img_brain_framed <- image_extent(combined_brains, 
                                       geometry_area(image_info(combined_brains)$width, 
                                                     image_info(combined_brains)$height + 50, 0, 0), gravity = "south", color = "white")
      ## Set up the title information
      effect_t <- ifelse(effect == "i ~ SES_T1", " -> Intercept of ", " -> Slope of ")
      brain_t <- ifelse(brain_v == "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_", "Regional Volume",
                        ifelse(brain_v == "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_", 
                               "Regional Area", "Regional Thickness"))
      ses_t <- ifelse(ses_v == "SES_neighbourhood", "Neighbourhood SES", "Household SES")
      title <- paste0(ses_t, effect_t, brain_t)
      ## Add the title
      img_brain_framed <- image_annotate(img_brain_framed, title, size = 25, color = "black", 
                            gravity = "north", location = "+0+0")
      ## Add the colourbar at the bottom, same width as the brain plot
      img_final <- img_brain_framed
      #img_cbar_resized <- image_resize(img_cbar, image_info(img_brain_framed)$width)
      #img_final <- image_append(c(img_brain_framed, img_cbar_resized), stack = TRUE)
      ## Add a small border on the outside
      img_final <- image_border(img_final, "white", "25x25")
      ## Save the result
      image_write(img_final, path = img_path, format = "png", density = "300")

      # Close the current viewer
      rgl::rgl.close()

} } } }
```

# Aim 2
### Global models 
```{r}

print("Running models for Aim 2 (SES -> Brain -> Outcomes) for people with genetic data, controlling for PGS of brain volume and cognition")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4

  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ a1*SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1
  s ~ a2*SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1
  
  # Mediators to outcome
  Outcome_T4 ~ b1*i + b2*s
  
  # Direct effect of predictor to outcome (and time-invariant covariates including PGS of general cognitive ability)
  Outcome_T4 ~ c_prime*SES_T1 + Sex + Agefmmean_T4 + PGSiq_T1
  
  # Indirect effects of predictor to outcome via mediators
  ab1 := a1*b1
  ab2 := a2*b2
  
  # Total effect
  total := c_prime + ab1 + ab2
  total_indirect := (a1*b1) + (a2*b2)

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    for (outcome_v in c("fc_p_sag_005_ses06A", 
                        "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A",
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]],data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_resid_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_resid_ses00A)
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])
  
  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(genetics_available == 1)

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim2_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", outcome_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
    }
  }
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_ind"
all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_std$fdr[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_std$p.value[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim2_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}
```

### - Regional plots: Aim 2
```{r}

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- suppressWarnings(read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting"))
  all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab1 := a1*b1"), "InterceptMediator")) %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab2 := a2*b2"), "SlopeMediator"))
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  relocate(outcome_label, .before = everything()) %>%
  select(-sig) %>%  # only keep what you need
  filter(interest_path_ind == "y") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome_label, brain_label) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  red_rows   <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] > 0
  blue_rows  <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] < 0
  white_rows <- is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) | is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) | df_wide[[fdr_col]] > 0.05
  
  if (any(red_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = red_rows,
        palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
        domain = c(0, global_max),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(blue_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = blue_rows,
        palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
        domain = c(global_min, 0),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(white_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = white_rows,
        palette = c("white", "white"),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "_colourtable.html"))

}

      title <- paste0(ses_t, effect_t, brain_t, " -> ", outcome_t)
```

# 6. Tertiary: European sample [PGS residualised]
```{r}
num <- '6'
```

## Aim 1
### Global models
```{r}

print("Running models for Aim 1 (SES -> Brain) for all people with genetic data, controlling for PGS of brain volume")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes) for people with genetics data
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]],data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))

  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_resid_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_resid_ses00A)
  
  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(use_genes == 1)
    
  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim1_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
  }
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_std$fdr[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_std$p.value[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}
```

### - Global plots (LMM style): Aim 1
```{r}

data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(Ancestry_ses00A == "European")

for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat",
                  "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat",
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  if (brain_v == "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat") { brain_label <- "Surface area" }
  if (brain_v == "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat") { brain_label <- "Cortical thickness" }
  if (brain_v == "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat") { brain_label <- "Volume" }
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  
  # Get long format data for plotting
data_curr$brain_diff <- data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]]
long_data <- data_curr %>% 
  select(participant_id, SES_household, SES_neighbourhood, brain_diff,
         ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, 
         ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A,
         paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A"), paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A"), 
         paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A"), paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(participant_id, SES_household, SES_neighbourhood, brain_diff),
    names_to = c(".value", "session"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_ses(\\d+)"
  )
m_br <- mean(long_data[[brain_v]], na.rm = T)
sd_br <- sd(long_data[[brain_v]], na.rm = T)
long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(brain_z = (long_data[[brain_v]] - m_br) / sd_br)

# Get the model info for plotting including parameters for intercept and slope
params <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_rInt", suffix,".xlsx"), sheet = "raw_estimates")
params <- params |> 
  filter(ses_label   == ses_v,
         brain_label == brain_v)
i_intercept <- params |> filter(term == "i ~1")        |> pull(estimate)
s_intercept <- params |> filter(term == "s ~1")        |> pull(estimate)
i_SS        <- params |> filter(term == "i ~ SES_T1")  |> pull(estimate)
s_SS        <- params |> filter(term == "s ~ SES_T1")  |> pull(estimate)
i_Sex       <- params |> filter(term == "i ~ Sex")     |> pull(estimate)
s_Sex       <- params |> filter(term == "s ~ Sex")     |> pull(estimate)
sex_ref <- 0
# wave mean ages for x-axis (raw years)
wave_ages <- c(10, 12, 14, 16)
# SES values
ss_mean <- mean(data_curr[[ses_v]], na.rm = TRUE)
ss_sd   <- sd(data_curr[[ses_v]],   na.rm = TRUE)

ss_vals <- c(
  "Mean - SD" = -1,
  "Mean"      =  0,
  "Mean + SD" =  1
)

# Estimate some model trajectories
implied_i_lo <- i_intercept + i_SS * (-1) + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_lo <- s_intercept + s_SS * (-1) + s_Sex * sex_ref

implied_i_mid <- i_intercept + i_SS * 0 + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_mid <- s_intercept + s_SS * 0 + s_Sex * sex_ref

implied_i_hi <- i_intercept + i_SS * (1) + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_hi <- s_intercept + s_SS * (1) + s_Sex * sex_ref

lgcm_lines <- bind_rows(
  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_lo  + implied_s_lo  * t, ss_group = "Mean - SD"),
  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_mid + implied_s_mid * t, ss_group = "Mean"),
  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_hi  + implied_s_hi  * t, ss_group = "Mean + SD")
) |>
  mutate(ss_group = factor(ss_group, levels = c("Mean - SD", "Mean", "Mean + SD")))

# Plot the result
plot_raw <- ggplot() +
  # Raw spaghetti lines per person (standardized brain values)
  geom_line(data = long_data,
            aes(x = ab_g_dyn__visit_age, y = brain_z, group = participant_id),
            color = "grey70", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.1) +
  # LGCM model-implied lines
  geom_line(data = lgcm_lines,
            aes(x = age_raw, y = brain_hat,
                color = ss_group, linetype = ss_group),
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  #geom_point(data = lgcm_lines,
  #           aes(x = age_raw, y = brain_hat, color = ss_group),
  #           size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Mean - SD" = "#4E95D9", "Mean" = "#215F9A", "Mean + SD" = "#0E2841"),
    name = "SES"
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Mean - SD" = "dashed", "Mean" = "longdash", "Mean + SD" = "solid"),
    name = "SES"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = brain_label) +
```

###  Regional models 
```{r}
for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1

'
  
# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each bilateral regional measure and save output for each model and measure
regions <- names(data_curr)[grep("lrav", names(data_curr))]
regions <- regions[!grepl("dsk__lrav", regions)]
region_list <- unique(substr(regions, 1, nchar(regions) - 7))
for (brain_v in region_list) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      
      # Define the current SES variable and standardize
      data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
      
      # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
      data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
      ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
      m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
      sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_resid_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_resid_ses00A)

  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(use_genes == 1)

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  #output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, "regional/3_Aim1_S2a_Regional_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, "_PGScov_EuroResidPGS.txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  #capture.output({
  #cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  #brain_v
  #ses_v
  #summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
  }
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_std$fdr[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_std$p.value[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr")
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}
```

### - Regional brain plots: Aim 1
```{r}

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting")
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  filter(interest_path_a == "y") %>%
  select(-sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(brain_label)
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
if (global_min < 0) {
  for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  tbl <- tryCatch( 
    { tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # Blue gradient for negative + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] < 0,
      palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
      domain = c(global_min, 0),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    ) },
    error = function(e) {
      tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    )
    } )
    } } else {
      for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  tbl <- tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05 (no negative values)
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    )
    }
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "colourtable.html"))
```

### Global models 
```{r}

print("Running models for Aim 2 (SES -> Brain -> Outcomes) for people with genetic data, controlling for PGS of brain volume and cognition")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4

  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ a1*SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1
  s ~ a2*SES_T1 + Sex + PGSvol_T1
  
  # Mediators to outcome
  Outcome_T4 ~ b1*i + b2*s
  
  # Direct effect of predictor to outcome (and time-invariant covariates including PGS of general cognitive ability)
  Outcome_T4 ~ c_prime*SES_T1 + Sex + Agefmmean_T4 + PGSiq_T1
  
  # Indirect effects of predictor to outcome via mediators
  ab1 := a1*b1
  ab2 := a2*b2
  
  # Total effect
  total := c_prime + ab1 + ab2
  total_indirect := (a1*b1) + (a2*b2)

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    for (outcome_v in c("fc_p_sag_005_ses06A", 
                        "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A",
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]],data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_resid_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_resid_ses00A)
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])
  
  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(use_genes == 1)

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim2_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", outcome_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
    }
  }
}
```

### - Regional brain plots: Aim 2
```{r}

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- suppressWarnings(read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting"))
  all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab1 := a1*b1"), "InterceptMediator")) %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab2 := a2*b2"), "SlopeMediator"))
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  relocate(outcome_label, .before = everything()) %>%
  select(-sig) %>%  # only keep what you need
  filter(interest_path_ind == "y") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome_label, brain_label) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  red_rows   <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] > 0
  blue_rows  <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] < 0
  white_rows <- is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) | is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) | df_wide[[fdr_col]] > 0.05
  
  if (any(red_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = red_rows,
        palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
        domain = c(0, global_max),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(blue_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = blue_rows,
        palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
        domain = c(global_min, 0),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(white_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = white_rows,
        palette = c("white", "white"),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "_colourtable.html"))

}

# Assign brain labels matching the format of fsbrain 
brain_data <- brain_data %>%
  mutate(
    fs_label = coalesce(
      # Try trimming 17 first
      label_frame$fsbrainLabel[match(
        substr(brain_label, 1, nchar(brain_label) - 17),
        substr(label_frame$Region, 1, nchar(label_frame$Region) - 3)
      )],
      # Fall back to trimming 18
      label_frame$fsbrainLabel[match(

        substr(label_frame$Region, 1, nchar(label_frame$Region) - 3)
      )]
    )
  )

# Create the brain plots for each sMRI and SES measure
  
  for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_")) {
  
    for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
      
      for (effect in c("ab1 := a1*b1", "ab2 := a2*b2")) {
        
        for (outcome_v in c("fc_p_sag_005_ses06A",

              subjects_dir       = template_subjects_dir,
              subject            = template_subject,
              atlas              = atlas,
              lh_region_value_list,
              rh_region_value_list,
              surface            = "inflated",
              makecmap_options   = makecmap_custom, 
              border = list(color = "grey90")
            ) }

      # Save png of brain image
      img_path <- file.path(output_path, paste0("plots/gene_corrected/", num,"_Aim2_brain_", 
                      brain_v, "_",  ses_v, "_", effect, "_",
                      outcome_v, suffix, "_betaPassFDR.png"))
      rgl::snapshot3d(filename = img_path,
        width = 4000, height = 4000, res = 600,
        webshot  = FALSE)
      
      # Save the plot at interactive html 
      brain_widget <- rgl::rglwidget(width = 900, height = 600)   # interactive WebGL
      htmlwidgets::saveWidget(widget = brain_widget,
        file = file.path(output_path, paste0("plots/htmls/", num, "_Aim2_brain_", brain_v, "_", 
                              ses_v, "_", effect, "_", outcome_v, suffix, "_betaPassFDR.html")),
        selfcontained = FALSE)

      # Save colourbar for the brain image
      cbar_path <- file.path(output_path, paste0("plots/colourbars/", num, "_Aim2_brain_", 
                           brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", 
                           effect, "_", outcome_v, suffix, "betaPassFDR_colorbar.png"))
      fsbrain::coloredmesh.plot.colorbar.separate(
        coloredmeshes = cm, # the object returned by vis.*
        show = FALSE, # don't pop up a window
        image.plot_extra_options = list(
        legend.lab  = "Beta",
        horizontal  = TRUE, # horizontal bar (default)
        legend.cex  = .65,
        legend.line = -1.6,
        smallplot = c(0.1, 0.9, 0.15, 0.17),
        axis.args = list(cex.axis = .65, # text size; tweak to taste
        cex.axis = .7, 
        mgp = c(3, 0.5, 0))
        ),
        png_options = list(
        filename = cbar_path,
        width    = 1400,            # pixels; make it big, you can down-scale later
        height   = 1400,
        res      = 300,
        bg       = "white"    # transparent background (RGBA)
        ),
      trim_png = TRUE               # auto-crop away empty marge (needs {magick})
      )
      
      # Save the final PNG with a plot title and the colourbar
      ## Reopen the brain plot and colourbar PNGs 
      img <- image_read(img_path)
      img_cbar  <- image_read(cbar_path)
      ## Trim the white space
      ### Crop around each brain separately
      info <- image_info(img)
      w_half <- info$width / 2
      h_half <- info$height / 2

      top_l <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, 0, 0)))
      btm_r <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, w_half, h_half)))

      # Combine into a single side-by-side row
      combined_brains <- image_append(
        c(image_border(top_l, "white", "5x5"),
         image_border(btm_r, "white", "5x5")),
        stack = FALSE
      )
      # Code for if you have left and right regions that are different (2x2 plot)
      # top_l <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, 0, 0)))
      # top_r <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, w_half, 0)))
      # btm_l <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, 0, h_half)))
      # btm_r <- image_trim(image_crop(img, geometry_area(w_half, h_half, w_half, h_half)))
      # ### Recombine the images
      # row1 <- image_append(c(image_border(top_l, "white", "5x5"), 
      #                  image_border(top_r, "white", "5x5")), stack = FALSE)
      # row2 <- image_append(c(image_border(btm_l, "white", "5x5"), 
      #                  image_border(btm_r, "white", "5x5")), stack = FALSE)
      # row2 <- image_resize(row2, geometry_size_pixels(width = image_info(row1)$width))
      # combined_brains <- image_append(c(row1, row2), stack = TRUE)
      ### Add a small border and space for the title
      img_brain_framed <- image_extent(combined_brains, 
                                       geometry_area(image_info(combined_brains)$width, 
                                                     image_info(combined_brains)$height + 50, 0, 0), gravity = "south", color = "white")
      ## Set up the title information
      effect_t <- ifelse(effect == "ab1 := a1*b1", " -> Intercept of ", " -> Slope of ")
      brain_t <- ifelse(brain_v == "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_", "Volume",
                        ifelse(brain_v == "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_", 
                               "Area", "Thickness"))
      ses_t <- ifelse(ses_v == "SES_neighbourhood", "Neighbourhood SES", "Household SES")
      outcome_t <- ifelse(outcome_v == "fc_p_sag_005_ses06A", "Grades T4", 
                   ifelse(outcome_v == "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A",
                          "Crystallized T4",  
                  ifelse(outcome_v == "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A",
                          "Card Sort T4",  
                   ifelse(outcome_v == "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                         "Flanker T4", "Processing Speed"))))
      title <- paste0(ses_t, effect_t, brain_t, " -> ", outcome_t)
      ## Add the title
      img_brain_framed <- image_annotate(img_brain_framed, title, size = 15, color = "black", 
                            gravity = "north", location = "+0+0")
      ## Add the colourbar at the bottom, same width as the brain plot
      img_final <- img_brain_framed
      #img_cbar_resized <- image_resize(img_cbar, image_info(img_brain_framed)$width)
      #img_final <- image_append(c(img_brain_framed, img_cbar_resized), stack = TRUE)
      ## Add a small border on the outside
      img_final <- image_border(img_final, "white", "25x25")
      ## Save the result
      image_write(img_final, path = img_path, format = "png", density = "300")

      # Close the current viewer
      rgl::rgl.close()

} } } } }
```

# 7. Tertiary: Full sample [PCs only no PGS, GLOBAL ONLY AIM 1]
```{r}
num <- '7'
suffix <- "_Whole_PCsOnly"
```
## Aim 1 
### Global model
```{r}

print("Running models for Aim 1 (SES -> Brain) for people with genetic data, controlling for PGS of brain volume")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes) for people with genetics data
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex + genPC01_T1 + genPC02_T1 + genPC03_T1 + genPC04_T1 + genPC05_T1 + genPC06_T1 + genPC07_T1 + genPC08_T1 + genPC09_T1 + genPC10_T1
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex + genPC01_T1 + genPC02_T1 + genPC03_T1 + genPC04_T1 + genPC05_T1 + genPC06_T1 + genPC07_T1 + genPC08_T1 + genPC09_T1 + genPC10_T1

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]],data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))

  # Standardize genetic-related variables
  data_curr$PGSiq_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_ses00A)
  data_curr$PGSvol_T1 <- scale(data_curr$SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC01_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__01_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC02_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__02_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC03_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__03_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC04_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__04_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC05_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__05_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC06_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__06_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC07_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__07_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC08_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__08_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC09_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__09_ses00A)
  data_curr$genPC10_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_stc__gen_pc__10_ses00A)
  
  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(genetics_available == 1)
    
  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim1_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
  }
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_std$fdr[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_std$p.value[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}
```

```{r}
# read + trim top
imgs <- lapply(file.path(folder, files), function(f) {
  im   <- image_read(f)
  info <- image_info(im)
  image_crop(im, geometry_area(
    width  = info$width,
    height = info$height - trim_top,
    x_off  = 0,
    y_off  = trim_top
  ))
})

# assemble one row: col1 col2 [gap] col3 col4
make_row <- function(row_imgs) {
  h  <- max(vapply(row_imgs, \(x) image_info(x)$height, integer(1)))
  sp <- image_blank(col_gap, h, color = bg)
  image_append(c(row_imgs[[1]], row_imgs[[2]], sp,
                 row_imgs[[3]], row_imgs[[4]]), stack = FALSE)
}

rows <- lapply(1:8, function(r) {
  idx <- ((r - 1) * 4 + 1):((r - 1) * 4 + 4)
  make_row(imgs[idx])
})

# stack rows with the specified vertical gaps
w      <- max(vapply(rows, \(x) image_info(x)$width, integer(1)))
result <- rows[[1]]
for (r in 2:8) {
  sp     <- image_blank(w, row_gaps[r - 1], color = bg)
  result <- image_append(c(result, sp, rows[[r]]), stack = TRUE)
}

image_write(result, paste0(output_path, "plots/figure2_layout.png"), format = "png", density = "300")
```

```{r}
imgs <- lapply(file.path(folder, files), function(f) {
  im   <- image_read(f)
  info <- image_info(im)
  image_crop(im, geometry_area(
    width  = info$width,
    height = info$height - trim_top,
    x_off  = 0,
    y_off  = trim_top
  ))
})

# assemble one row: col1 col2 [gap] col3 col4
make_row <- function(row_imgs) {
  h  <- max(vapply(row_imgs, \(x) image_info(x)$height, integer(1)))
  sp <- image_blank(col_gap, h, color = bg)
  image_append(c(row_imgs[[1]], row_imgs[[2]], sp,
                 row_imgs[[3]], row_imgs[[4]]), stack = FALSE)
}

rows <- lapply(1:9, function(r) {
  idx <- ((r - 1) * 4 + 1):((r - 1) * 4 + 4)
  make_row(imgs[idx])
})

# stack rows with the specified vertical gaps
w      <- max(vapply(rows, \(x) image_info(x)$width, integer(1)))
result <- rows[[1]]
for (r in 2:9) {
  sp     <- image_blank(w, row_gaps[r - 1], color = bg)
  result <- image_append(c(result, sp, rows[[r]]), stack = TRUE)
}

image_write(result, paste0(output_path, "plots/figure3_layout.png"), format = "png", density = "300")

```

```{r}
imgs <- lapply(file.path(folder, files), function(f) {
  im   <- image_read(f)
  info <- image_info(im)
  image_crop(im, geometry_area(
    width  = info$width,
    height = info$height - trim_top,
    x_off  = 0,
```
```{r}
    y_off  = trim_top
  ))
})

# assemble one row: col1 col2 [gap] col3 col4
make_row <- function(row_imgs) {
  h  <- max(vapply(row_imgs, \(x) image_info(x)$height, integer(1)))
  sp <- image_blank(col_gap, h, color = bg)
  image_append(c(row_imgs[[1]], row_imgs[[2]], row_imgs[[3]], sp,
                 row_imgs[[4]], row_imgs[[5]], row_imgs[[6]]), stack = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
rows <- lapply(1:9, function(r) {
  idx <- ((r - 1) * 6 + 1):((r - 1) * 6 + 6)
  make_row(imgs[idx])
})

# stack rows with the specified vertical gaps
w      <- max(vapply(rows, \(x) image_info(x)$width, integer(1)))
result <- rows[[1]]
for (r in 2:9) {
  sp     <- image_blank(w, row_gaps[r - 1], color = bg)
  result <- image_append(c(result, sp, rows[[r]]), stack = TRUE)
}

image_write(result, paste0(output_path, "plots/figures8_full_layout.png"), format = "png", density = "300")

```
