# ____
# SUPPLEMENT

## Quadratic
### Global model Aim 1
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_quadratic'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

print("Running models for Aim 1 (SES -> Brain) for people with genetic data, controlling for PGS of brain volume")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes) for people with genetics data
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4
  q =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 4*Brain_T3 + 9*Brain_T4
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  i ~~ q
  s ~~ q
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex
  q ~ SES_T1 + Sex

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]],data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim1_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
  }
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std[all_std$term == "q ~ SES_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"

all_raw$interest_path_a <- NA_real_
all_raw[all_raw$term == "i ~ SES_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"
all_raw[all_raw$term == "s ~ SES_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"
all_raw[all_raw$term == "q ~ SES_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"

all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
all_raw$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_std$fdr[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_std$p.value[all_std[[path]] %in% "y" & all_std$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
  all_raw$fdr[all_raw[[path]] %in% "y" & all_raw$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_raw$p.value[all_raw[[path]] %in% "y" & all_raw$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}

```

### - Global plots (LMM style): Aim 1
```{r}

data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1)

for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat",
                  "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat",
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  if (brain_v == "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat") { brain_label <- "Surface area" }
  if (brain_v == "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat") { brain_label <- "Cortical thickness" }
  if (brain_v == "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat") { brain_label <- "Volume" }
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  
  # Get long format data for plotting
data_curr$brain_diff <- data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]]
long_data <- data_curr %>% 
  select(participant_id, SES_household, SES_neighbourhood, brain_diff,
         ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, 
         ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A,
         paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A"), paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A"), 
         paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A"), paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(participant_id, SES_household, SES_neighbourhood, brain_diff),
    names_to = c(".value", "session"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_ses(\\d+)"
  )
m_br <- mean(long_data[[brain_v]], na.rm = T)
sd_br <- sd(long_data[[brain_v]], na.rm = T)
long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(brain_z = (long_data[[brain_v]] - m_br) / sd_br)

# Get the model info for plotting including parameters for intercept and slope
params <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_rInt", suffix,".xlsx"), sheet = "raw_estimates")
params <- params |> 
  filter(ses_label   == ses_v,
         brain_label == brain_v)
i_intercept <- params |> filter(term == "i ~1")        |> pull(estimate)
s_intercept <- params |> filter(term == "s ~1")        |> pull(estimate)
i_SS        <- params |> filter(term == "i ~ SES_T1")  |> pull(estimate)
s_SS        <- params |> filter(term == "s ~ SES_T1")  |> pull(estimate)
i_Sex       <- params |> filter(term == "i ~ Sex")     |> pull(estimate)
s_Sex       <- params |> filter(term == "s ~ Sex")     |> pull(estimate)
q_intercept <- params |> filter(term == "q ~1")        |> pull(estimate)
q_SS        <- params |> filter(term == "q ~ SES_T1")  |> pull(estimate)
q_Sex       <- params |> filter(term == "q ~ Sex")     |> pull(estimate)
sex_ref <- 0
# wave mean ages for x-axis (raw years)
wave_ages <- c(10, 12, 14, 16)
# SES values
ss_mean <- mean(data_curr[[ses_v]], na.rm = TRUE)
ss_sd   <- sd(data_curr[[ses_v]],   na.rm = TRUE)

ss_vals <- c(
  "Mean - SD" = -1,
  "Mean"      =  0,
  "Mean + SD" =  1
)

# Estimate some model trajectories
implied_i_lo <- i_intercept + i_SS * (-1) + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_lo <- s_intercept + s_SS * (-1) + s_Sex * sex_ref
implied_q_lo  <- q_intercept + q_SS * (-1) + q_Sex * sex_ref

implied_i_mid <- i_intercept + i_SS * 0 + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_mid <- s_intercept + s_SS * 0 + s_Sex * sex_ref
implied_q_mid <- q_intercept + q_SS *  0   + q_Sex * sex_ref

implied_i_hi <- i_intercept + i_SS * (1) + i_Sex * sex_ref
implied_s_hi <- s_intercept + s_SS * (1) + s_Sex * sex_ref
implied_q_hi  <- q_intercept + q_SS * ( 1) + q_Sex * sex_ref

# fine t grid spanning the observed waves (t = 0..3)
t_grid   <- seq(0, 3, length.out = 100)
# map t back to age: age = 10 + 2*t  (since waves are 10,12,14,16)
age_grid <- 10 + 2 * t_grid

lgcm_lines <- bind_rows(
  tibble(t = t_grid, age_raw = age_grid,
         brain_hat = implied_i_lo  + implied_s_lo  * t + implied_q_lo  * t^2,
         ss_group = "Mean - SD"),
  tibble(t = t_grid, age_raw = age_grid,
         brain_hat = implied_i_mid + implied_s_mid * t + implied_q_mid * t^2,
         ss_group = "Mean"),
  tibble(t = t_grid, age_raw = age_grid,
         brain_hat = implied_i_hi  + implied_s_hi  * t + implied_q_hi  * t^2,
         ss_group = "Mean + SD")
) |>
  mutate(ss_group = factor(ss_group, levels = c("Mean - SD", "Mean", "Mean + SD")))

#lgcm_lines <- bind_rows(
#  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_lo  + implied_s_lo  * t, #ss_group = "Mean - SD"),
#  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_mid + implied_s_mid * t, #ss_group = "Mean"),
#  tibble(age_raw = wave_ages, t = c(0,1,2,3), brain_hat = implied_i_hi  + implied_s_hi  * t, #ss_group = "Mean + SD")
#) |>
#  mutate(ss_group = factor(ss_group, levels = c("Mean - SD", "Mean", "Mean + SD")))

# Plot the result
plot_raw <- ggplot() +
  # Raw spaghetti lines per person (standardized brain values)
  geom_line(data = long_data,
            aes(x = ab_g_dyn__visit_age, y = brain_z, group = participant_id),
            color = "grey70", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.1) +
  # LGCM model-implied lines
  geom_line(data = lgcm_lines,
            aes(x = age_raw, y = brain_hat,
                color = ss_group, linetype = ss_group),
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  #geom_point(data = lgcm_lines,
  #           aes(x = age_raw, y = brain_hat, color = ss_group),
  #           size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Mean - SD" = "#4E95D9", "Mean" = "#215F9A", "Mean + SD" = "#0E2841"),
    name = "SES"
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Mean - SD" = "dashed", "Mean" = "longdash", "Mean + SD" = "solid"),
    name = "SES"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = brain_label) +
  theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
                          axis.text = element_text(size = 20),  
                          axis.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold")) + 
  guides(
  color = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      linewidth = 1.2,
      linetype  = c("dashed", "longdash", "solid"),
      shape     = NA)))
ggsave(paste0(output_path,"plots/other/",num,"_Aim1_output_quadratic_direction_plot_",brain_v,"_", ses_v, suffix,".png"), plot = plot_raw, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

plot_raw2 <- plot_raw + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(9.5, 17), breaks = c(10, 12, 14, 16), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1),  # since standardised this is +- 1 SD
                     expand = c(0.01, 0)) + theme(legend.position = "none",
                     plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10))
ggsave(paste0(output_path,"plots/other/",num,"_Aim1_output_quadratic_direction_plot_",brain_v,"_", ses_v,suffix,"_restrictY.png"), plot = plot_raw2, width = 4.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

}

}
```

### Global model Aim 2
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_quadratic'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

print("Running models for Aim 2 (SES -> Brain -> Outcomes)")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4 
  q =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 4*Brain_T3 + 9*Brain_T4 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  i ~~ q
  s ~~ q
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates
  i ~ a1*SES_T1 + Sex
  s ~ a2*SES_T1 + Sex
  q ~ a3*SES_T1 + Sex
  
  # Mediators to outcome
  Outcome_T4 ~ b1*i + b2*s + b3*q
  
  # Direct effect of predictor to outcome (and time-invariant covariates)
  Outcome_T4 ~ c_prime*SES_T1 + Sex + Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Indirect effects of predictor to outcome via mediators
  ab1 := a1*b1
  ab2 := a2*b2
  ab3 := a3*b3
  
  # Total effect
  total := c_prime + ab1 + ab2 + ab3

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()
plot_data <- list()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    for (outcome_v in c("fc_p_sag_005_ses06A", 
                        "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR",
                    cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim2_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", outcome_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)

  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
  all_raw$fdr[all_raw[[path]] %in% "y" & all_raw$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_raw$p.value[all_raw[[path]] %in% "y" & all_raw$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr")
```

### Global model Aim 2 (Euro)
```{r}
num <- 'Supp_distal'
suffix <- "_Euro_NoPGS"

print("Running models for Aim 2 (SES -> Brain -> Outcomes)")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates
  i ~ a1*SES_T1 + Sex
  s ~ a2*SES_T1 + Sex
  
  # Mediators to outcome
  Outcome_T4 ~ b1*i + b2*s
  
  # Direct effect of predictor to outcome (and time-invariant covariates)
  Outcome_T4 ~ c_prime*SES_T1 + Sex + Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Indirect effects of predictor to outcome via mediators
  ab1 := a1*b1
  ab2 := a2*b2
  
  # Total effect
  total := c_prime + ab1 + ab2

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()
plot_data <- list()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    for (outcome_v in c("fc_p_sag_005_ses06A", 
                        "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])
  
  data_curr <- data_curr %>% filter(Ancestry_ses00A == "European")

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR",
                    cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim2_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", outcome_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
```

### - Regional brain plots: Aim 2
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_distal'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- suppressWarnings(read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting"))
  all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab1 := a1*b1"), "InterceptMediator")) %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab2 := a2*b2"), "SlopeMediator"))
  all_std$estimate <- as.numeric(all_std$estimate)
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  relocate(outcome_label, .before = everything()) %>%
  select(-sig) %>%  # only keep what you need
  filter(interest_path_ind == "y") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome_label, brain_label) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  red_rows   <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] > 0
  blue_rows  <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] < 0
  white_rows <- is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) | is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) | df_wide[[fdr_col]] > 0.05
  
  if (any(red_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = red_rows,
        palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
        domain = c(0, global_max),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(blue_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = blue_rows,
        palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
        domain = c(global_min, 0),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(white_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = white_rows,
        palette = c("white", "white"),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "_colourtable.html"))

}
```

### - Arranging Figure - full sample (distal)
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_distal'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS_distal"

folder  <- paste0(output_path, "plots")
dpi     <- 300
pt2px   <- function(pt) round(pt * dpi / 72)
trim_top  <- pt2px(14)
col_gap   <- pt2px(40)
row_gaps  <- vapply(c(0, 0, 0, 0, 20, 0, 0, 0), pt2px, 1)
bg        <- "white"  

files <- read.xlsx("/path/Supplementary_plotting_order.xlsx")
files <- files[[suffix]]

# read + trim top
imgs <- lapply(file.path(folder, files), function(f) {
  im   <- image_read(f)
  info <- image_info(im)
  image_crop(im, geometry_area(
    width  = info$width,
    height = info$height - trim_top,
    x_off  = 0,
    y_off  = trim_top
  ))
})

# assemble one row: col1 col2 [gap] col3 col4
make_row <- function(row_imgs) {
  h  <- max(vapply(row_imgs, \(x) image_info(x)$height, integer(1)))
  sp <- image_blank(col_gap, h, color = bg)
  image_append(c(row_imgs[[1]], row_imgs[[2]], row_imgs[[3]], sp,
                 row_imgs[[4]], row_imgs[[5]], row_imgs[[6]]), stack = FALSE)
}

rows <- lapply(1:9, function(r) {
  idx <- ((r - 1) * 6 + 1):((r - 1) * 6 + 6)
  make_row(imgs[idx])
})

# stack rows with the specified vertical gaps
w      <- max(vapply(rows, \(x) image_info(x)$width, integer(1)))
result <- rows[[1]]
for (r in 2:9) {
  sp     <- image_blank(w, row_gaps[r - 1], color = bg)
  result <- image_append(c(result, sp, rows[[r]]), stack = TRUE)
}

image_write(result, paste0(output_path, "plots/figures8_full_layout_distal.png"), format = "png", density = "300")
```

## Control for total in regional analysis Aim 1
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_totalcontrol'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1 + TotalBrain_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2 + TotalBrain_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3 + TotalBrain_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4 + TotalBrain_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  TotalBrain_T1 ~~ TotalBrain_T2 + TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4
  TotalBrain_T2 ~~ TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4
  TotalBrain_T3 ~~ TotalBrain_T4
  
  SES_T1 ~~ TotalBrain_T1 + TotalBrain_T2 + TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4
  Sex ~~ TotalBrain_T1 + TotalBrain_T2 + TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4
  TotalBrain_T1 + TotalBrain_T2 + TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4 ~ 1
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates
  i ~ SES_T1 + Sex
  s ~ SES_T1 + Sex # no MRI model or site as ComBat removed already

'


# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each bilateral regional measure and save output for each model and measure
regions <- names(data_curr)[grep("lrav", names(data_curr))]
regions <- regions[!grepl("dsk__lrav", regions)]
region_list <- unique(substr(regions, 1, nchar(regions) - 7))
for (brain_v in region_list) {
  
  if (substring(brain_v, 1, 13) == "mr_y_smri__ar") {
    total_name = "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat" }
  if (substring(brain_v, 1, 13) == "mr_y_smri__th") {
    total_name = "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat" }
  if (substring(brain_v, 1, 13) == "mr_y_smri__vo") {
    total_name = "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat" }

  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    print(ses_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      
      # Define the current SES variable and standardize
      data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
      
      # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
      data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
      ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
      m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
      sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
      data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
  all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)

    }
  }

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
all_report$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & all_report$ses_label == ses_v], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, 
    standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}
```

```{r}
num <- 'Supp_totalcontrol'

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting")
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1", "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_T1", "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
#global_max_aim1 <- global_max
global_max_aim1 <- 0.3 # change here to manually set coloubar bounds

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  filter(interest_path_a == "y") %>%
  select(-sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(brain_label)
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  tbl <- tryCatch( 
    { tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # Blue gradient for negative + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] < 0,
      palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
      domain = c(global_min, 0),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    ) },
    error = function(e) {
      tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    )
    }
  )
  
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "_colourtable.html"))

}
```

```{r}

num <- 'Supp_totalcontrol'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

folder  <- paste0(output_path, "plots")
dpi     <- 300
pt2px   <- function(pt) round(pt * dpi / 72)
trim_top  <- pt2px(14)
col_gap   <- pt2px(22)
row_gaps  <- vapply(c(1), pt2px, 1)
bg        <- "white"  

files <- c("Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__area__dsk__SES_household_i ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png", "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__thk__dsk__SES_household_i ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",
           "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__vol__dsk__SES_household_i ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",
           "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__area__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_i ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png", "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__thk__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_i ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",
           "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__vol__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_i ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",
           "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__area__dsk__SES_household_s ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png", "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__thk__dsk__SES_household_s ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",
           "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__vol__dsk__SES_household_s ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",
           "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__area__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_s ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png", "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__thk__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_s ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",
           "Supp_totalcontrol_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__vol__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_s ~ SES_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png"
)

# read + trim top
imgs <- lapply(file.path(folder, files), function(f) {
  im   <- image_read(f)
  info <- image_info(im)
  image_crop(im, geometry_area(
    width  = info$width,
    height = info$height - trim_top,
    x_off  = 0,
    y_off  = trim_top
  ))
})

# assemble one row: col1 col2 [gap] col3 col4
make_row <- function(row_imgs) {
  h  <- max(vapply(row_imgs, \(x) image_info(x)$height, integer(1)))
  sp <- image_blank(col_gap, h, color = bg)
  image_append(c(row_imgs[[1]], row_imgs[[2]], row_imgs[[3]], sp,
                 row_imgs[[4]], row_imgs[[5]], row_imgs[[6]]), stack = FALSE)
}

rows <- lapply(1:2, function(r) {
  idx <- ((r - 1) * 6 + 1):((r - 1) * 6 + 6)
  make_row(imgs[idx])
})

# stack rows with the specified vertical gaps
w      <- max(vapply(rows, \(x) image_info(x)$width, integer(1)))
result <- rows[[1]]
for (r in 2) {
  sp     <- image_blank(w, row_gaps[r - 1], color = bg)
  result <- image_append(c(result, sp, rows[[r]]), stack = TRUE)
}

image_write(result, paste0(output_path, "plots/figures2_supp_controltotal_layout.png"), format = "png", density = "300")
```

```{r}
num <- 'Supp_totalcontrol'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

print("Running models for Aim 2 (SES -> Brain -> Outcomes)")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1 + TotalBrain_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2 + TotalBrain_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3 + TotalBrain_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4 + TotalBrain_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  TotalBrain_T1 ~~ TotalBrain_T2 + TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4
  TotalBrain_T2 ~~ TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4
  TotalBrain_T3 ~~ TotalBrain_T4
  
  SES_T1 ~~ TotalBrain_T1 + TotalBrain_T2 + TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4
  Sex ~~ TotalBrain_T1 + TotalBrain_T2 + TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4
  TotalBrain_T1 + TotalBrain_T2 + TotalBrain_T3 + TotalBrain_T4 ~ 1
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates
  i ~ a1*SES_T1 + Sex
  s ~ a2*SES_T1 + Sex
  
  # Mediators to outcome
  Outcome_T4 ~ b1*i + b2*s
  
  # Direct effect of predictor to outcome (and time-invariant covariates)
  Outcome_T4 ~ c_prime*SES_T1 + Sex + Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Indirect effects of predictor to outcome via mediators
  ab1 := a1*b1
  ab2 := a2*b2
  
  # Total effect
  total := c_prime + ab1 + ab2
  total_indirect := (a1*b1) + (a2*b2)

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
regions <- names(data_curr)[grep("lrav", names(data_curr))]
regions <- regions[!grepl("dsk__lrav", regions)]
region_list <- unique(substr(regions, 1, nchar(regions) - 7))

for (brain_v in region_list) { 

  if (substring(brain_v, 1, 13) == "mr_y_smri__ar") {
    total_name = "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat" }
  if (substring(brain_v, 1, 13) == "mr_y_smri__th") {
    total_name = "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat" }
  if (substring(brain_v, 1, 13) == "mr_y_smri__vo") {
    total_name = "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat" }
  
  for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
    
    for (outcome_v in c(                  "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A",
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A", "fc_p_sag_005_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

    br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  
  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_T1 <- scale(data_curr[[ses_v]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T3 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
    all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  #output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, "regional/2_Aim2_output_regional_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", outcome_v, "_", combat_type, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  #capture.output({
  #cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
```

### - Regional brain plots: Aim 2
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_totalcontrol'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- suppressWarnings(read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting"))
  all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab1 := a1*b1"), "InterceptMediator")) %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("ab2 := a2*b2"), "SlopeMediator"))

# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05,][["estimate"]], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator" & all_std$fdr < .05, ][["estimate"]], na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  relocate(outcome_label, .before = everything()) %>%
  select(-sig) %>%  # only keep what you need
  filter(interest_path_ind == "y") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome_label, brain_label) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  red_rows   <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] > 0
  blue_rows  <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] < 0
  white_rows <- is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) | is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) | df_wide[[fdr_col]] > 0.05
  
  if (any(red_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = red_rows,
        palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
        domain = c(0, global_max),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(blue_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = blue_rows,
        palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
        domain = c(global_min, 0),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(white_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = white_rows,
        palette = c("white", "white"),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "_colourtable.html"))

}
```

### - Arranging Figure S20 - full sample, total controlled
```{r}

library(beepr)

folder  <- paste0(output_path, "plots")
dpi     <- 300
pt2px   <- function(pt) round(pt * dpi / 72)
trim_top  <- pt2px(14)
col_gap   <- pt2px(40)
row_gaps  <- vapply(c(0, 0, 0, 0, 20, 0, 0, 0), pt2px, 1)
bg        <- "white"  

num <- 'Supp'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS_totalcontrol"
files <- read.xlsx("/path/Supplementary_plotting_order.xlsx")
files <- files[[suffix]]

# read + trim top
imgs <- lapply(file.path(folder, files), function(f) {
  im   <- image_read(f)
  info <- image_info(im)
  image_crop(im, geometry_area(
    width  = info$width,
    height = info$height - trim_top,
    x_off  = 0,
    y_off  = trim_top
  ))
})

# assemble one row: col1 col2 [gap] col3 col4
make_row <- function(row_imgs) {
  h  <- max(vapply(row_imgs, \(x) image_info(x)$height, integer(1)))
  sp <- image_blank(col_gap, h, color = bg)
  image_append(c(row_imgs[[1]], row_imgs[[2]], row_imgs[[3]], sp,
                 row_imgs[[4]], row_imgs[[5]], row_imgs[[6]]), stack = FALSE)
}

rows <- lapply(1:9, function(r) {
  idx <- ((r - 1) * 6 + 1):((r - 1) * 6 + 6)
  make_row(imgs[idx])
})

# stack rows with the specified vertical gaps
w      <- max(vapply(rows, \(x) image_info(x)$width, integer(1)))
result <- rows[[1]]
for (r in 2:9) {
  sp     <- image_blank(w, row_gaps[r - 1], color = bg)
  result <- image_append(c(result, sp, rows[[r]]), stack = TRUE)
}

image_write(result, paste0(output_path, "plots/figuress8_full_layout_totalcontrol.png"), format = "png", density = "300")

beep(sound = 1, expr = NULL)
beep(sound = 1, expr = NULL)
beep(sound = 1, expr = NULL)
print("REMEMBER THAT THE LAST ROW IS PATTERN NOT GRADES LIKE OTHERS")
beep(sound = 1, expr = NULL)
beep(sound = 1, expr = NULL)
beep(sound = 1, expr = NULL)
```

```{r}
# Retrieve the data
data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1)

# Correlation matrix + matrix of p-values
x_vars <- c("mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat_ses00A",
               "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat_ses02A",
               "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat_ses04A",
               "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat_ses06A",
               "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat_ses00A",
               "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat_ses02A",
               "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat_ses04A",
               "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat_ses06A",
               "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A",
               "fc_p_sag_005_ses06A"
                #,"SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood"
                )
y_vars <- c("SCORE1_AVG_PGSvol_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__01_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__02_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__03_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__04_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__05_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__06_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__07_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__08_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__09_ses00A",
            "ab_g_stc__gen_pc__10_ses00A",
            "SCORE1_AVG_PGSiq_ses00A")

# Correlations and p-values for every x–y pair
res <- expand.grid(x = x_vars, y = y_vars, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    test = list(cor.test(data_curr[[x]], data_curr[[y]], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")),
    r    = test$estimate,
    p    = test$p.value
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", r,
                    cut(p, c(-Inf, .001, .01, .05, Inf),
                        labels = c("***", "**", "*", ""))),
    x = factor(x, levels = x_vars),
    y = factor(y, levels = rev(y_vars))
  )

corplot <- ggplot(res, aes(x, y, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey90") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3B4CC0", mid = "white", high = "#B40426",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "r") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  coord_fixed()
```

## Control for other SES 

### Global model Aim 1
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_controlSES'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

print("Running models for Aim 1 (SES -> Brain) for people with genetic data, controlling for PGS of brain volume")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes) for people with genetics data
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4

  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  SES_household_T1 ~~ SES_neighbourhood_T1
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates (including PGS for brain volume on latent brain variables, and PCs of genetic ancestry)
  i ~ a1*SES_household_T1 + a3*SES_neighbourhood_T1 + Sex
  s ~ a2*SES_household_T1 + a4*SES_neighbourhood_T1 + Sex
  
  # Wald test comparing two SES effects
  diff_i := a1 - a3
  diff_s := a2 - a4

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
    print("")
    print(brain_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]],data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_household_T1 <- scale(data_curr[["SES_household"]])
  data_curr$SES_neighbourhood_T1 <- scale(data_curr[["SES_neighbourhood"]])

  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = "none")
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
  all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim1_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_a"
all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_household_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"
all_std[all_std$term == "s ~ SES_household_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"
all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"
all_std[all_std$term == "s ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"

all_report$interest_path_a <- NA_real_
all_report[all_report$term == "i ~ SES_household_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"
all_report[all_report$term == "s ~ SES_household_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"
all_report[all_report$term == "i ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"
all_report[all_report$term == "s ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1", "interest_path_a"] <- "y"

all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
all_report$fdr <- NA_real_
for (ses_v in c("SES_household", "SES_neighbourhood")) {
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & grepl(ses_v, all_report$term)] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & grepl(ses_v, all_report$term)], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}

```

### - Regional brain plots: Aim 1
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_controlSES'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients 
  # which can be computed most reliably)
  all_std <- read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting")
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_household_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_household_T1" | all_std$term == "i ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1", "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "i ~ SES_household_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_household_T1" | all_std$term == "i ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1" | all_std$term == "s ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1", "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
#global_max_aim1 <- global_max
global_max_aim1 <- 0.3 # change here to manually set coloubar bounds

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  filter(interest_path_a == "y") %>%
  select(-sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(brain_label)
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  tbl <- tryCatch( 
    { tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # Blue gradient for negative + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] < 0,
      palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
      domain = c(global_min, 0),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    ) },
    error = function(e) {
      tbl %>%
    # Red gradient for positive + fdr >= .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & .data[[est_col]] > 0,
      palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
      domain = c(0, global_max),
      na_color = "white"
    ) %>%
    # White for fdr < .05
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(est_col),
      rows = .data[[fdr_col]] > 0.05,
      palette = c("white", "white"),
      na_color = "white"
    )
    }
  )
  
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim1_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, "_colourtable.html"))

}

# Prepare template brain 
fsbrain::download_fsaverage6(accept_freesurfer_license = TRUE)

    )

# Create the brain plots for each sMRI and SES measure
  
  for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_",

      ## Set up the title information
      effect_t <- ifelse(effect == "i ~ SES_household_T1" | effect == "i ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1", " -> Intercept of ", " -> Slope of ")
```

```{r}
           "Supp_controlSES_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__vol__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_i ~ SES_neighbourhood_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",
           "Supp_controlSES_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__area__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_s ~ SES_household_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png", "Supp_controlSES_Aim1_brain_mr_y_smri__thk__dsk__SES_neighbourhood_s ~ SES_household_T1_Whole_NoPGS_betaPassFDR.png",

# read + trim top
imgs <- lapply(file.path(folder, files), function(f) {
  im   <- image_read(f)
  info <- image_info(im)
  image_crop(im, geometry_area(
    width  = info$width,
    height = info$height - trim_top,
    x_off  = 0,
    y_off  = trim_top
  ))
})

# assemble one row: col1 col2 [gap] col3 col4
make_row <- function(row_imgs) {
  h  <- max(vapply(row_imgs, \(x) image_info(x)$height, integer(1)))
  sp <- image_blank(col_gap, h, color = bg)
  image_append(c(row_imgs[[1]], row_imgs[[2]], row_imgs[[3]], sp,
                 row_imgs[[4]], row_imgs[[5]], row_imgs[[6]]), stack = FALSE)
}

rows <- lapply(1:4, function(r) {
  idx <- ((r - 1) * 6 + 1):((r - 1) * 6 + 6)
  make_row(imgs[idx])
})

# stack rows with the specified vertical gaps
w      <- max(vapply(rows, \(x) image_info(x)$width, integer(1)))
result <- rows[[1]]
for (r in 2:4) {
  sp     <- image_blank(w, row_gaps[r - 1], color = bg)
  result <- image_append(c(result, sp, rows[[r]]), stack = TRUE)
}

image_write(result, paste0(output_path, "plots/figure_aim1s_controlSES_layout.png"), format = "png", density = "300")
```

### Global model Aim 2
```{r}

num <- 'Supp_controlSES'
suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS"

print("Running models for Aim 2 (SES -> Brain -> Outcomes)")

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {

  # Define the correct longitudinal ComBat version (random intercepts/intercepts+slopes)
  if (combat_type == "rInt") { data_curr <- data_longCB %>% filter(use_main == 1) }
  if (combat_type == "rIntNLin") { data_curr <- data_longCB_int_nonlinear %>% filter(use_main == 1) }

# Define the LCGM
model_lin <- '
  
  # Intercept and slopes
  i =~ 1*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 1*Brain_T3 + 1*Brain_T4
  s =~ 0*Brain_T1 + 1*Brain_T2 + 2*Brain_T3 + 3*Brain_T4 
  
  # Time-varying covariates
  Brain_T1 ~ Agefmmean_T1
  Brain_T2 ~ Agefmmean_T2
  Brain_T3 ~ Agefmmean_T3
  Brain_T4 ~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Covariance structure
  i ~~ s
  SES_household_T1 ~~ SES_neighbourhood_T1
  Agefmmean_T1 ~~ Agefmmean_T2 + Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T2 ~~ Agefmmean_T3 + Agefmmean_T4
  Agefmmean_T3 ~~ Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates
  i ~ a1*SES_household_T1 + a3*SES_neighbourhood_T1 + Sex
  s ~ a2*SES_household_T1 + a4*SES_neighbourhood_T1 + Sex
  
  # Mediators to outcome
  Outcome_T4 ~ b1*i + b2*s
  
  # Direct effect of predictor to outcome (and time-invariant covariates)
  Outcome_T4 ~ c_prime_ho*SES_household_T1 + c_prime_ne*SES_neighbourhood_T1 + Sex + Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Indirect effects of predictor to outcome via mediators
  abiho := a1*b1
  absho := a2*b2
  abine := a3*b1
  absne := a4*b2
  
  # Total effect
  total := c_prime_ho + c_prime_ne + abiho + absho + abine + absne
  
  # Wald test comparing two SES effects
  diff_i := a1 - a3
  diff_s := a2 - a4
  diff_med_i := abiho - abine
  diff_med_s := absho - absne

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()
plot_data <- list()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
for (brain_v in c("mr_y_smri__thk__dsk_mean.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__area__dsk_sum.combat", 
                  "mr_y_smri__vol__dsk_sum.combat")) {
  
    for (outcome_v in c("fc_p_sag_005_ses06A", 
                        "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_household_T1 <- scale(data_curr[["SES_household"]])
  data_curr$SES_neighbourhood_T1 <- scale(data_curr[["SES_neighbourhood"]])
  
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR",
                    cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
  all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)
  
  # print full model output 
  output_file <- paste0(fullmodel_path, num, "_Aim2_output_linear_", brain_v, "_", ses_v, "_", outcome_v, "_", combat_type, suffix, ".txt")
  # Open the file for appending results
  capture.output({
  cat("Model output of linear SEM", "\n")
  brain_v
  ses_v
  summary(fit_lin) }, file = output_file, append = TRUE)
  
    }
}

# FDR correct by SES measure over the paths of interest
path <- "interest_path_ind"
all_std[all_std$term == "ab3 := a3*b3", "interest_path_ind"] <- "y"
all_report$interest_path_ind <- NA_real_
all_report[all_report$term == "abiho := a1*b1", "interest_path_ind"] <- "y"
all_report[all_report$term == "absho := a2*b2", "interest_path_ind"] <- "y"
all_report[all_report$term == "abine := a3*b1", "interest_path_ind"] <- "y"
all_report[all_report$term == "absne := a4*b2", "interest_path_ind"] <- "y"

all_std$fdr <- NA_real_
all_report$fdr <- NA_real_

for (ses_v in c("ho", "ne")) {
  all_report$fdr[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & grepl(ses_v, all_report$term)] <- p.adjust(all_report$p.value[all_report[[path]] %in% "y" & grepl(ses_v, all_report$term)], method = "fdr") 
}

# Save the output 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    reporting = all_report, standardized_estimates = all_std,
    raw_estimates = all_raw,
    fit_statistics = all_fit
  ),
  path = paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim2_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx")
)

}
```

```{r}
  # Predictors and time-invariant covariates
  i ~ a1*SES_household_T1 + a3*SES_neighbourhood_T1 + Sex
  s ~ a2*SES_household_T1 + a4*SES_neighbourhood_T1 + Sex
  
  # Mediators to outcome
  Outcome_T4 ~ b1*i + b2*s
  
  # Direct effect of predictor to outcome (and time-invariant covariates)
  Outcome_T4 ~ c_prime_ho*SES_household_T1 + c_prime_ne*SES_neighbourhood_T1 + Sex + Agefmmean_T4
  
  # Indirect effects of predictor to outcome via mediators
  abiho := a1*b1
  absho := a2*b2
  abine := a3*b1
  absne := a4*b2
  
  # Total effect
  total := c_prime_ho + c_prime_ne + abiho + absho + abine + absne

'

# Set up empty frames to store outputs
all_raw <- data.frame()
all_std <- data.frame()
all_fit <- data.frame()
all_report <- data.frame()

# Run the model for each global measure and save output for each model and measure
regions <- names(data_curr)[grep("lrav", names(data_curr))]
regions <- regions[!grepl("dsk__lrav", regions)]
region_list <- unique(substr(regions, 1, nchar(regions) - 7))
for (brain_v in region_list) {
  
    for (outcome_v in c(                  "Crystallized_Calc_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__flnkr__uncor_score_ses06A", 
                        "nc_y_nihtb__crdst__uncor_score_ses06A",
                        "nc_y_nihtb__pttcp__uncor_score_ses06A", "fc_p_sag_005_ses06A")) {
    
      print("")
      print(brain_v)
      print(ses_v)
      print(outcome_v)
    
  # Define the current brain variable and standardize over all waves
  br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
  m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
  sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Brain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  data_curr$Brain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(brain_v,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br

    br <- c(data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses00A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses02A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses04A")]], data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses06A")]]) # standardize across all data at once
      m_br <- mean(br, na.rm=T)
      sd_br <- sd(br, na.rm=T)
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T1 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses00A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T2 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses02A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T3 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses04A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
      data_curr$TotalBrain_T4 <- (data_curr[[paste0(total_name,"_ses06A")]] - m_br)/sd_br
  
  # Define the current SES variable and standardize
  data_curr$SES_household_T1 <- scale(data_curr[["SES_household"]])
  data_curr$SES_neighbourhood_T1 <- scale(data_curr[["SES_neighbourhood"]])
    
  # Standardize over all waves and prepare any other variables in the model
  data_curr$Sex <- ifelse(data_curr$ab_g_stc__cohort_sex_ses00A == 1, -0.5, 0.5) # center sex on 0
  ages <- c(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A) # standardize across all data at once
  m_age <- mean(ages, na.rm=T)
  sd_age <- sd(ages, na.rm=T)
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T1 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses00A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T2 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses02A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T3 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses04A, na.rm = T))
  data_curr$Agefmmean_T4 <- scale(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A - mean(data_curr$ab_g_dyn__visit_age_ses06A, na.rm = T))
  
  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T4 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  # Standardize outcome variable 
  data_curr$Outcome_T3 <- scale(data_curr[[outcome_v]])

  fit_lin <- growth(model_lin, data = data_curr, missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ab_g_stc__design_id__fam_ses00A", fixed.x = FALSE)
  out <- tidy_lavaan_fit(fit_lin, original_data = data_curr, id_col = "participant_id", model_name = "linear, combat site+scanner model, age+sex", brain_label = brain_v, ses_label = ses_v, outcome_label = outcome_v)
  all_std <- bind_rows(all_std, out$standardized_estimates)
  all_raw <- bind_rows(all_raw, out$raw_estimates)
  all_fit <- bind_rows(all_fit, out$fit_statistics)
  all_report <- bind_rows(all_report, out$reporting)

  }
```

```{r}
num <- 'Supp_controlSES'

for (combat_type in c("rInt")) {
  
  # Retrieve the data (using the reporting sheet which has the standardised estimate, 
  # plus p value and FDR corrected p value from the unstandardised coefficients

  all_std <- suppressWarnings(read_excel(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting"))
  all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("abiho := a1*b1"), "InterceptMediator_H")) %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("absho := a2*b2"), "SlopeMediator_H")) %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("abine := a3*b1"), "InterceptMediator_N")) %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, fixed("absne := a4*b2"), "SlopeMediator_N"))
  
# Step 1: Get global min/max for colour bar
all_std <- all_std %>% mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
global_min <- min(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator_H" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator_H" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "InterceptMediator_N" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator_N" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(all_std[all_std$term == "InterceptMediator_H" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator_H" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "InterceptMediator_N" & all_std$fdr < .05 | all_std$term == "SlopeMediator_N" & all_std$fdr < .05, "estimate"], na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 2: Filter and pivot wider
df_wide <- all_std %>%
  mutate(region = substr(str_extract(brain_label, "(?<=mr_y_smri__)...."), 1, 4)) %>%
  relocate(region, .before = everything()) %>%
  relocate(outcome_label, .before = everything()) %>%
  select(-sig) %>%  # only keep what you need
  filter(interest_path_ind == "y") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value, fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome_label, brain_label) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("estimate", "fdr", "p.value")), ~replace(., is.infinite(.), NA)))
est_cols <- names(df_wide)[startsWith(names(df_wide), "estimate_")]

# Step 3: Get corresponding fdr columns for each estimate column
fdr_cols <- gsub("estimate_", "fdr_", est_cols)

# Step 4: Build gt table
tbl <- gt(df_wide) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("model")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("param_type")) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("interest_path"))

# Step 5: Apply colour scaling per estimate column
for (i in seq_along(est_cols)) {
  est_col <- est_cols[i]
  fdr_col <- fdr_cols[i]
  
  red_rows   <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] > 0
  blue_rows  <- !is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) & !is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) & df_wide[[fdr_col]] <= 0.05 & df_wide[[est_col]] < 0
  white_rows <- is.na(df_wide[[fdr_col]]) | is.na(df_wide[[est_col]]) | df_wide[[fdr_col]] > 0.05
  
  if (any(red_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = red_rows,
        palette = c("lightsalmon", "darkred"),
        domain = c(0, global_max),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(blue_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = blue_rows,
        palette = c("darkblue", "lightblue"),
        domain = c(global_min, 0),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
  
  if (any(white_rows)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      data_color(
        columns = all_of(est_col),
        rows = white_rows,
        palette = c("white", "white"),
        na_color = "white"
      )
  }
}

gtsave(tbl, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/", num, "_Aim2_Regional_", combat_type, suffix,"_colourtable.html"))
```
