```{r}
# read + trim top
imgs <- lapply(file.path(folder, files), function(f) {
  im   <- image_read(f)
  info <- image_info(im)
  image_crop(im, geometry_area(
    width  = info$width,
    height = info$height - trim_top,
    x_off  = 0,
    y_off  = trim_top
  ))
})

# assemble one row: col1 col2 [gap] col3 col4
make_row <- function(row_imgs) {
  h  <- max(vapply(row_imgs, \(x) image_info(x)$height, integer(1)))
  sp <- image_blank(col_gap, h, color = bg)
  image_append(c(row_imgs[[1]], row_imgs[[2]], row_imgs[[3]], sp,
                 row_imgs[[4]], row_imgs[[5]], row_imgs[[6]]), stack = FALSE)
}

rows <- lapply(1:9, function(r) {
  idx <- ((r - 1) * 6 + 1):((r - 1) * 6 + 6)
  make_row(imgs[idx])
})

# stack rows with the specified vertical gaps
w      <- max(vapply(rows, \(x) image_info(x)$width, integer(1)))
result <- rows[[1]]
for (r in 2:9) {
  sp     <- image_blank(w, row_gaps[r - 1], color = bg)
  result <- image_append(c(result, sp, rows[[r]]), stack = TRUE)
}

image_write(result, paste0(output_path, "plots/figure_aim2s_controlSES_layout.png"), format = "png", density = "300")
```

```{r}
# Set up asterisks function for uncorrected p values
stars_f <- function(p) case_when(is.na(p) ~ "",
                               p < .001 ~ "***",
                               p < .01  ~ "**",
                               p < .05  ~ "*",
                               TRUE     ~ "")

fmt_fdr <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
```

```{r}
outs <- list()

# Loop over each sample/model and extract the variables
#for (num in c('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', 'Supp_controlSES', 'Supp_totalcontrol')) {
for (num in c('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6')) {

  if (num == '1') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }
  if (num == '2') { suffix <- "_Whole_PGSPC" }
  if (num == '3') { suffix <- "_Euro_NoPGS" }
  if (num == '4') { suffix <- "_Euro_PGSPC" }
  if (num == '5') { suffix <- "_Whole_PGSResid" }
  if (num == '6') { suffix <- "_Euro_PGSResid" }
  if (num == 'Supp_controlSES') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }
  if (num == 'Supp_totalcontrol') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }

dat_a <- read.xlsx(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "reporting")
dat_b <- read.xlsx(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "standardized_estimates")
dat_c <- read.xlsx(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "raw_estimates")

# Frame A: SES terms (beta, p_unc, fdr)
a <- dat_a |>
  mutate(term = trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", term))) |>
  filter(term %in% c("i ~ SES_T1", "s ~ SES_T1")) |>
  transmute(brain_label, ses_label, key = ifelse(term == "i ~ SES_T1", "i", "s"),
            bs  = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", estimate), stars_f(p.value)), 
            fdr = fmt_fdr(fdr)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = c(bs, fdr)) |>
  select(brain_label, ses_label,
         `i ~ SES beta` = bs_i, `i ~ SES fdr`  = fdr_i,
         `s ~ SES beta` = bs_s, `s ~ SES pfdr` = fdr_s)

# Frame B: Sex and PGS (beta in one cell)
terms_b <- c("i ~ Sex", "s ~ Sex", "i ~ PGSvol_T1", "s ~ PGSvol_T1")
b <- dat_b |>
  mutate(term = trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", term))) |>
  filter(term %in% terms_b) |>
  transmute(brain_label, ses_label, key = paste0(term, "_beta"),
            bs = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", estimate))) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = bs)

# Frame C: Sex and PGS (p_unc in one cell)
c <- dat_c |>
  mutate(term = trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", term))) |>
  filter(term %in% terms_b) |>
  transmute(brain_label, ses_label, key = paste0(term, "_p"),
            ps = paste0(stars_f(p.value))) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = ps)

out_frame <- full_join(full_join(a, b, by = c("brain_label", "ses_label")), 
                       c, by = c("brain_label", "ses_label")) |>
    mutate(model = paste0(num, suffix), .before = 1) |> 
    arrange(model, brain_label, ses_label)

outs[[paste0(num, suffix)]] <- out_frame                   
}

out_all <- bind_rows(outs)

for (f in terms_b) {
  
out_all[[paste0(f)]] <- paste0(out_all[[paste0(f, "_beta")]], out_all[[paste0(f, "_p")]]) 
out_all[[paste0(f, "_beta")]] <- NULL
out_all[[paste0(f, "_p")]] <- NULL

}

write_xlsx(out_all, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/aim1_parameters_table.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
              bs = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", estimate), stars_f(fdr))) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = bs) |>
    select(brain_label, ses_label,
           !!paste0("ab1 := a1*b1 ", cog_v) := "ab1 := a1*b1",
           !!paste0("ab2 := a2*b2 ", cog_v) := "ab2 := a2*b2",
         ) |>
    mutate(model = suffix, .before = 1)

outs[[cog_v]] <- out_frame                   
}
}

out_all <- reduce(outs, full_join, by = c("brain_label", "ses_label"))

write_xlsx(out_all, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/aim2_parameters_table_regional.xlsx"))


```


## Fit statistics (global)
### Aim 1
```{r}

# Set up asterisks function for uncorrected p values
stars_f <- function(p) case_when(is.na(p) ~ "",
                               p < .001 ~ "***",
                               p < .01  ~ "**",
                               p < .05  ~ "*",
                               TRUE     ~ "")

fmt_fdr <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
                                        x < .001 ~ "<.001",
                                        TRUE     ~ sprintf("%.3f", x))

outs <- list()

# Loop over each sample/model and extract the variables
#for (num in c('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', 'Supp_controlSES', 'Supp_totalcontrol')) {
for (num in c('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6')) {

  if (num == '1') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }
  if (num == '2') { suffix <- "_Whole_PGSPC" }
  if (num == '3') { suffix <- "_Euro_NoPGS" }
  if (num == '4') { suffix <- "_Euro_PGSPC" }
  if (num == '5') { suffix <- "_Whole_PGSResid" }
  if (num == '6') { suffix <- "_Euro_PGSResid" }
  if (num == 'Supp_controlSES') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }
  if (num == 'Supp_totalcontrol') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }

dat_a <- read.xlsx(paste0(output_path, num, "_Aim1_Global_", combat_type, suffix, ".xlsx"), sheet = "fit_statistics")

# Frame A: SES terms (beta, p_unc, fdr)
terms_fit <- c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "pvalue.scaled",
                   "cfi.robust", "tli.robust",
                   "rmsea.robust", "rmsea.ci.lower.robust", 
                    "rmsea.ci.upper.robust", "srmr")
out_frame <- dat_a |>
  arrange(brain_label, ses_label) |>
  filter(measure %in% terms_fit) |>
    transmute(brain_label, ses_label, measure,
              val = case_when(is.na(value) ~ NA_character_,
                              measure == "pvalue.scaled" ~ 
                                fmt_fdr(as.numeric(value)),
                              TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(value)))) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = val) |>
    select(brain_label, ses_label, any_of(terms_fit)) |>
    mutate(model = suffix, .before = 1)

outs[[suffix]] <- out_frame                   
}

out_all <- bind_rows(outs) |>
  select(any_of(c("model", "brain_label", "ses_label", terms_fit)), everything())

write_xlsx(out_all, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/aim1_fit_table.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
for (num in c('Supp_controlSES')) {

  if (num == '1') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }

  mutate(term = trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", term))) |>

  transmute(brain_label, ses_label, key = gsub(" ~ ", "_", term),
            bs  = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", estimate), stars_f(p.value)),

  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = c(bs, fdr)) |>
  select(brain_label, ses_label,
         `i ~ SES_household beta` = bs_i_SES_household_T1, 
         `i ~ SES_household fdr` = fdr_i_SES_household_T1,

         `i ~ SES_neighbourhood beta` = bs_i_SES_neighbourhood_T1,
         `i ~ SES_neighbourhood fdr` = fdr_i_SES_neighbourhood_T1,
         `s ~ SES_neighbourhood beta` = bs_s_SES_neighbourhood_T1,
         `s ~ SES_neighbourhood fdr` = fdr_s_SES_neighbourhood_T1)

# Frame B: Sex and PGS (beta + p_unc in one cell)
b <- dat_b |>
  mutate(term = trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", term))) |>
  filter(term %in% c("SES_household_T1 ~~ SES_neighbourhood_T1")) |>
  transmute(brain_label, ses_label, term,
            bs = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", estimate), stars_f(p.value))) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = bs)

out_frame <- full_join(a, b, by = c("brain_label", "ses_label")) |>
  arrange(brain_label, ses_label) |> 
    mutate(model = suffix, .before = 1)

outs[[suffix]] <- out_frame                   
}

out_all <- bind_rows(outs)

write_xlsx(out_all, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/aim1_parameters_table_controlSES.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
    arrange(brain_label, ses_label) |> filter(outcome_label == cog_v) |>
    mutate(term = trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", term))) |>
    filter(term %in% c("ab1 := a1*b1", "ab2 := a2*b2")) |>
    transmute(brain_label, ses_label, term,
              bs = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", estimate), stars_f(fdr))) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = bs) |>
    select(brain_label, ses_label,
           !!paste0("ab1 := a1*b1 ", cog_v) := "ab1 := a1*b1",
           !!paste0("ab2 := a2*b2 ", cog_v) := "ab2 := a2*b2",
         ) |>
    mutate(model = cog_v, .before = 1)

outs[[cog_v]] <- out_frame                   
}
}

out_all <- reduce(outs, full_join, by = c("brain_label", "ses_label"))

write_xlsx(out_all, paste0(output_path, "merged_output/aim2_parameters_table_global_distal.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
  if (num == '6') { suffix <- "_Euro_PGSResid" }
  if (num == 'Supp_controlSES') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }
  if (num == 'Supp_totalcontrol') { suffix <- "_Whole_NoPGS" }
```

```{r}
                "mr_y_smri__thk__dsk__",

    arrange(brain_label, ses_label) |>
    mutate(term = trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", term))) |>
    filter(term %in% c("i ~ SES_T1", "s ~ SES_T1")) |>
    transmute(brain_label, ses_label, term,
              bs = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", estimate), stars_f(fdr))) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = bs) |>

         ) |>
    mutate(model = sub("_mean.combat","", sub("_sum.combat","", sub(paste0("^", brain_v), "", brain_label))), .before = 1)

outs[[brain_v]] <- out_frame                   
}
}
```
